verses.text_gb: [Fn1]那说[Cra]方言的，原不是对人说，乃是对神说，因为没有人听出来，然而他在[Crb]灵里却是讲说各样的[Crc]奥秘。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]那說[Cra]方言的，原不是對人說，乃是對神說，因為沒有人聽出來，然而他在[Crb]靈裏卻是講說各樣的[Crc]奧祕。
verses.text_en: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men but to God; for no one hears, but in his spirit he speaks mysteries.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那说方言的，原不是对人说，乃是对神说，因为没有人听出来，然而他在灵里却是讲说各样的奥秘。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那說方言的，原不是對人說，乃是對神說，因為沒有人聽出來，然而他在靈裏卻是講說各樣的奧祕。

footnotes.zh: 使徒在2～6节的话，使人清楚明确的看见，说方言远不及申言重要。他很强的贬低说方言的恩赐，而高举申言的恩赐，因为他主要的关切是召会，不是单个的信徒。说方言，即使是真正和正确的，也不过造就那说的人，但申言却建造召会。在启示里申言，或用清楚明白的话在知识里教导，比用人所不懂的话说方言，对召会更有益处。
footnotes.zh_big5: 使徒在2～6節的話，使人清楚明確的看見，說方言遠不及申言重要。他很強的貶低說方言的恩賜，而高舉申言的恩賜，因為他主要的關切是召會，不是單個的信徒。說方言，即使是真正和正確的，也不過造就那說的人，但申言卻建造召會。在啟示裏申言，或用清楚明白的話在知識裏教導，比用人所不懂的話說方言，對召會更有益處。
footnotes.en: 14:2 1 For The apostle's word in vv. 2-6 gives a clear and definite view that speaking in tongues is much less important than prophesying. Speaking in tongues, even if it is genuine and proper, edifies only the speaker himself, but prophesying builds up the church. To prophesy in revelation or to teach in knowledge with clear, understandable words is more profitable to the church than to speak in tongues with unknown words (v. 19).

refs.text_gb: 另有一人能行异能，另有一人能申言，另有一人能辨别诸灵，另有别人能说各种方言，另有一人能翻方言。
refs.text_big5: 另有一人能行異能，另有一人能申言，另有一人能辨別諸靈，另有別人能說各種方言，另有一人能繙方言。
refs.text_en: And to another operations of works of power, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits; to a different one various kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.

refs.text_gb: 我感谢神，我说方言比你们众人还多，
refs.text_big5: 我感謝神，我說方言比你們眾人還多，
refs.text_en: I thank God, I speak in tongues more than all of you,

refs.text_gb: 但在召会中，我宁愿用我的心思说五句话，可以教导人，强如用方言说万句话。
refs.text_big5: 但在召會中，我寧願用我的心思說五句話，可以教導人，強如用方言說萬句話。
refs.text_en: But in the church I would rather speak five words with my mind, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in a tongue.

refs.text_gb: 这样，方言不是给信的人作表记，乃是给不信的人；但申言不是给不信的人作表记，乃是给信的人。
refs.text_big5: 這樣，方言不是給信的人作表記，乃是給不信的人；但申言不是給不信的人作表記，乃是給信的人。
refs.text_en: So then tongues are for a sign, not to those who believe but to the unbelievers; but prophecy is for a sign not to the unbelievers but to those who believe.

refs.text_gb: 所以若全召会聚在一处的时候，众人都说方言，有不通方言的，或是不信的人进来，岂不说你们癫狂了么？
refs.text_big5: 所以若全召會聚在一處的時候，眾人都說方言，有不通方言的，或是不信的人進來，豈不說你們癲狂了麼？
refs.text_en: If therefore the whole church comes together in one place, and all speak in tongues, and some unlearned in tongues or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are insane?

refs.text_gb: 因为我若用方言祷告，我的灵就祷告，我的心思却没有作用。
refs.text_big5: 因為我若用方言禱告，我的靈就禱告，我的心思卻沒有作用。
refs.text_en: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

refs.text_gb: 这却怎么样？我要用灵祷告，也要用心思祷告；我要用灵歌唱，也要用心思歌唱。
refs.text_big5: 這卻怎麼樣？我要用靈禱告，也要用心思禱告；我要用靈歌唱，也要用心思歌唱。
refs.text_en: What then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray also with the mind; I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing also with the mind.

refs.text_gb: 不然，你若用灵祝福，在场那不通方言的人，既然不晓得你所说的，怎能在你感谢的时候说阿们？
refs.text_big5: 不然，你若用靈祝福，在場那不通方言的人，既然不曉得你所說的，怎能在你感謝的時候說阿們？
refs.text_en: Otherwise if you bless with the spirit, how shall he who fills the place of the unlearned in tongues say the Amen at your giving of thanks, since he does not know what you are saying?

refs.text_gb: 我若有申言的恩赐，也明白一切的奥秘，和一切的知识，并有全备的信，以致能够移山，却没有爱，我就算不得什么。
refs.text_big5: 我若有申言的恩賜，也明白一切的奧祕，和一切的知識，並有全備的信，以致能彀移山，卻沒有愛，我就算不得甚麼。
refs.text_en: And if I have the gift of prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to remove mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.

verses.text_gb: 但那申言的，是对人讲说[Fn1][Cra]建造、勉励和安慰。
verses.text_big5: 但那申言的，是對人講說[Fn1][Cra]建造、勉勵和安慰。
verses.text_en: But he who prophesies speaks building up and encouragement and consolation to men.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但那申言的，是对人讲说建造、勉励和安慰。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但那申言的，是對人講說建造、勉勵和安慰。

footnotes.zh: 或，造就。既然申言说出主，把基督供应给人，就建造人，给人勉励和安慰。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，造就。既然申言說出主，把基督供應給人，就建造人，給人勉勵和安慰。
footnotes.en: 14:3 1 building Or, edification. Since prophesying, speaking forth the Lord, ministers Christ to people, it builds up people and gives them encouragement and consolation.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，这却怎么样？每逢你们聚在一起的时候，各人或有诗歌，或有教训，或有启示，或有方言，或有翻出来的话，凡事都当为建造。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，這卻怎麼樣？每逢你們聚在一起的時候，各人或有詩歌，或有教訓，或有啟示，或有方言，或有繙出來的話，凡事都當為建造。
refs.text_en: What then, brothers? Whenever you come together, each one has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. Let all things be done for building up.

refs.text_gb: 关于祭偶像之物，我们晓得我们都有知识。知识是叫人自高自大，唯有爱建造人。
refs.text_big5: 關於祭偶像之物，我們曉得我們都有知識。知識是叫人自高自大，惟有愛建造人。
refs.text_en: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

refs.text_gb: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都建造人。
refs.text_big5: 凡事都可行，但不都有益處；凡事都可行，但不都建造人。
refs.text_en: All things are lawful, but not all things are profitable; all things are lawful, but not all things build up.

verses.text_gb: 那说方言的，是建造自己，但那申言的，乃是[Fn1][Cra]建造[Crb]召会。
verses.text_big5: 那說方言的，是建造自己，但那申言的，乃是[Fn1][Cra]建造[Crb]召會。
verses.text_en: He who speaks in a tongue builds up himself, but he who prophesies builds up the church.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那说方言的，是建造自己，但那申言的，乃是建造召会。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那說方言的，是建造自己，但那申言的，乃是建造召會。

footnotes.zh: 申言说出主，不仅建造单个圣徒，更建造召会。
footnotes.zh_big5: 申言說出主，不僅建造單個聖徒，更建造召會。
footnotes.en: 14:4 1 builds Prophesying, speaking forth the Lord, builds up not only the individual saints but also the church.

refs.text_gb: 你们也是如此，既渴慕灵，就要为着召会的建造，寻求得以超越。
refs.text_big5: 你們也是如此，既渴慕靈，就要為著召會的建造，尋求得以超越。
refs.text_en: So also you, since you are zealous of spirits, seek that you may excel for the building up of the church.

refs.text_gb: 我照神所给我的恩典，好像一个智慧的工头，立好了根基，有别人在上面建造，只是各人要谨慎怎样在上面建造。
refs.text_big5: 我照神所給我的恩典，好像一個智慧的工頭，立好了根基，有別人在上面建造，只是各人要謹慎怎樣在上面建造。
refs.text_en: According to the grace of God given to me, as a wise master builder I have laid a foundation, and another builds upon it. But let each man take heed how he builds upon it.

refs.text_gb: 写信给在哥林多神的召会，就是给在基督耶稣里被圣别，蒙召的圣徒，同着所有在各处呼求我们主耶稣基督之名的人；祂是他们的，也是我们的；
refs.text_big5: 寫信給在哥林多神的召會，就是給在基督耶穌裏被聖別，蒙召的聖徒，同著所有在各處呼求我們主耶穌基督之名的人；祂是他們的，也是我們的；
refs.text_en: To the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who have been sanctified in Christ Jesus, the called saints, with all those who call upon the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, who is theirs and ours:

refs.text_gb: 不拘对犹太人，对希利尼人，对神的召会，你们都不要成为绊脚石；
refs.text_big5: 不拘對猶太人，對希利尼人，對神的召會，你們都不要成為絆腳石；
refs.text_en: Do not become a stumbling block, both to Jews and to Greeks and to the church of God;

verses.text_gb: 我愿意你们都说方言，但我更愿意你们[Cra]申言；说方言的，若不[Crb]翻出来，使召会得建造，那申言的，就比他[Fn1][Crc]强了。
verses.text_big5: 我願意你們都說方言，但我更願意你們[Cra]申言；說方言的，若不[Crb]繙出來，使召會得建造，那申言的，就比他[Fn1][Crc]強了。
verses.text_en: I desire that you all speak in tongues, but especially that you would prophesy; and greater is he who prophesies than he who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, that the church may receive building up.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我愿意你们都说方言，但我更愿意你们申言；说方言的，若不翻出来，使召会得建造，那申言的，就比他强了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我願意你們都說方言，但我更願意你們申言；說方言的，若不繙出來，使召會得建造，那申言的，就比他強了。

footnotes.zh: 直译，大。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，大。

refs.text_gb: 你们要追求爱，更要切慕属灵的恩赐，尤其要切慕申言。
refs.text_big5: 你們要追求愛，更要切慕屬靈的恩賜，尤其要切慕申言。
refs.text_en: Pursue love, and desire earnestly spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

refs.text_gb: 所以那说方言的，就当祷告，使他能翻出来。
refs.text_big5: 所以那說方言的，就當禱告，使他能繙出來。
refs.text_en: Therefore let him who speaks in a tongue pray that he may interpret.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，这却怎么样？每逢你们聚在一起的时候，各人或有诗歌，或有教训，或有启示，或有方言，或有翻出来的话，凡事都当为建造。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，這卻怎麼樣？每逢你們聚在一起的時候，各人或有詩歌，或有教訓，或有啟示，或有方言，或有繙出來的話，凡事都當為建造。
refs.text_en: What then, brothers? Whenever you come together, each one has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. Let all things be done for building up.

refs.text_gb: 若有人说方言，只好两个人，至多三个人，且要轮流着说，也要有一个人翻出来；
refs.text_big5: 若有人說方言，只好兩個人，至多三個人，且要輪流著說，也要有一個人繙出來；
refs.text_en: If anyone speaks in a tongue, it should be by two, or at the most three, and in turn, and one should interpret;

refs.text_gb: 若没有翻的人，就当在召会中静默，只对自己和神说就是了。
refs.text_big5: 若沒有繙的人，就當在召會中靜默，只對自己和神說就是了。
refs.text_en: But if there is no interpreter, he should be silent in the church, and speak to himself and to God.

refs.text_gb: 但在召会中，我宁愿用我的心思说五句话，可以教导人，强如用方言说万句话。
refs.text_big5: 但在召會中，我寧願用我的心思說五句話，可以教導人，強如用方言說萬句話。
refs.text_en: But in the church I would rather speak five words with my mind, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in a tongue.

refs.text_gb: 但你们要切慕那更大的恩赐。我还要把极超越的路指示你们。
refs.text_big5: 但你們要切慕那更大的恩賜。我還要把極超越的路指示你們。
refs.text_en: But earnestly desire the greater gifts. And moreover I show to you a most excellent way.

verses.text_gb: 弟兄们，我到你们那里去，若只说[Cra]方言，与你们有什么[Crb]益处？除非我用[Crc]启示，或[Crd]知识，或[Cre]预言，或[Crf]教训，对你们讲说。
verses.text_big5: 弟兄們，我到你們那裏去，若只說[Cra]方言，與你們有甚麼[Crb]益處？除非我用[Crc]啟示，或[Crd]知識，或[Cre]豫言，或[Crf]教訓，對你們講說。
verses.text_en: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, what will I profit you, unless I speak to you either in revelation or in knowledge or in prophecy or in teaching?
verses.text_gb_plain: 弟兄们，我到你们那里去，若只说方言，与你们有什么益处？除非我用启示，或知识，或预言，或教训，对你们讲说。
verses.text_big5_plain: 弟兄們，我到你們那裏去，若只說方言，與你們有甚麼益處？除非我用啟示，或知識，或豫言，或教訓，對你們講說。

refs.text_gb: 但在召会中，我宁愿用我的心思说五句话，可以教导人，强如用方言说万句话。
refs.text_big5: 但在召會中，我寧願用我的心思說五句話，可以教導人，強如用方言說萬句話。
refs.text_en: But in the church I would rather speak five words with my mind, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in a tongue.

refs.text_gb: 只是那灵的表显赐给各人，是要叫人得益处。
refs.text_big5: 只是那靈的表顯賜給各人，是要叫人得益處。
refs.text_en: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for what is profitable.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，这却怎么样？每逢你们聚在一起的时候，各人或有诗歌，或有教训，或有启示，或有方言，或有翻出来的话，凡事都当为建造。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，這卻怎麼樣？每逢你們聚在一起的時候，各人或有詩歌，或有教訓，或有啟示，或有方言，或有繙出來的話，凡事都當為建造。
refs.text_en: What then, brothers? Whenever you come together, each one has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. Let all things be done for building up.

refs.text_gb: 愿我们主耶稣基督的神，荣耀的父，赐给你们智慧和启示的灵，使你们充分的认识祂；
refs.text_big5: 願我們主耶穌基督的神，榮耀的父，賜給你們智慧和啟示的靈，使你們充分的認識祂；
refs.text_en: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the full knowledge of Him,

refs.text_gb: 就是照着启示使我知道这奥秘，正如我前面略略写过的，
refs.text_big5: 就是照著啟示使我知道這奧祕，正如我前面略略寫過的，
refs.text_en: That by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I have written previously in brief,

refs.text_gb: 这奥秘在别的世代中，未曾给人们的子孙知道，像如今在灵里启示祂的圣使徒和申言者一样；
refs.text_big5: 這奧祕在別的世代中，未曾給人們的子孫知道，像如今在靈裏啟示祂的聖使徒和申言者一樣；
refs.text_en: Which in other generations was not made known to the sons of men, as it has now been revealed to His holy apostles and prophets in spirit,

refs.text_gb: 因为你们在基督里，在一切的发表和知识上，样样都得以富足，
refs.text_big5: 因為你們在基督裏，在一切的發表和知識上，樣樣都得以富足，
refs.text_en: That in everything you were enriched in Him, in all utterance and all knowledge,

refs.text_gb: 这人借着那灵得了智慧的言语，那人也照同一位灵得了知识的言语，
refs.text_big5: 這人藉著那靈得了智慧的言語，那人也照同一位靈得了知識的言語，
refs.text_en: For to one through the Spirit a word of wisdom is given, and to another a word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;

refs.text_gb: 我的弟兄们，我自己也深信你们是满有良善，充满了各样的知识，也能彼此劝戒。
refs.text_big5: 我的弟兄們，我自己也深信你們是滿有良善，充滿了各樣的知識，也能彼此勸戒。
refs.text_en: But I myself also am persuaded concerning you, my brothers, that you yourselves also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

refs.text_gb: 另有一人能行异能，另有一人能申言，另有一人能辨别诸灵，另有别人能说各种方言，另有一人能翻方言。
refs.text_big5: 另有一人能行異能，另有一人能申言，另有一人能辨別諸靈，另有別人能說各種方言，另有一人能繙方言。
refs.text_en: And to another operations of works of power, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits; to a different one various kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.

refs.text_gb: “神说，在末后的日子，我要将我的灵浇灌在一切属肉体的人身上；你们的儿女要说预言，你们的青年人要见异象，你们的老年人要作异梦。
refs.text_big5: “神說，在末後的日子，我要將我的靈澆灌在一切屬肉體的人身上；你們的兒女要說豫言，你們的青年人要見異象，你們的老年人要作異夢。
refs.text_en: "And it shall be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out of My Spirit upon all flesh, and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream things in dreams;

refs.text_gb: 在那些日子，我要将我的灵浇灌在我的奴仆和婢女身上，他们就要说预言。
refs.text_big5: 在那些日子，我要將我的靈澆灌在我的奴僕和婢女身上，他們就要說豫言。
refs.text_en: And indeed upon My slaves, both men and women, I will pour out of My Spirit in those days, and they shall prophesy.

refs.text_gb: 他有四个女儿，都是童女，是说预言的。
refs.text_big5: 他有四個女兒，都是童女，是說豫言的。
refs.text_en: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，这却怎么样？每逢你们聚在一起的时候，各人或有诗歌，或有教训，或有启示，或有方言，或有翻出来的话，凡事都当为建造。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，這卻怎麼樣？每逢你們聚在一起的時候，各人或有詩歌，或有教訓，或有啟示，或有方言，或有繙出來的話，凡事都當為建造。
refs.text_en: What then, brothers? Whenever you come together, each one has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. Let all things be done for building up.

refs.text_gb: 他们都坚定持续在使徒的教训和交通里，持续擘饼和祷告。
refs.text_big5: 他們都堅定持續在使徒的教訓和交通裏，持續擘餅和禱告。
refs.text_en: And they continued steadfastly in the teaching and the fellowship of the apostles, in the breaking of bread and the prayers.

verses.text_gb: 就是那[Fn1]无生命而发声之物，或箫、或琴，若发出来的声调[Fn2]没有分别，怎能知道所吹所弹的是什么？

verses.text_en: Yet even lifeless things, whether flute or harp, in giving a sound, if they give no distinction in the tones, how will what is played on the flute or on the harp be known?

footnotes.zh: 使徒在7～11节的例证，指出哥林多的信徒荒谬的滥说方言，发出没有分别的声调(7)，吹出“无定的号声。”(8。)他们也过度的使用方言，无论在什么地方，用什么方法，或在什么情形里，都说方言。因此，他规正并约束他们，不滥用也不过度的使用这种益处最少的小恩赐，叫他们能追求更大的恩赐，好更多的造就圣徒并建造召会。
footnotes.zh_big5: 使徒在7～11節的例證，指出哥林多的信徒荒謬的濫說方言，發出沒有分別的聲調，（7，）吹出“無定的號聲。”（8。）他們也過度的使用方言，無論在甚麼地方，用甚麼方法，或在甚麼情形裏，都說方言。因此，他規正並約束他們，不濫用也不過度的使用這種益處最少的小恩賜，叫他們能追求更大的恩賜，好更多的造就聖徒並建造召會。
footnotes.en: 14:7 2 no The apostle's illustrations in vv. 7-11 indicate that the Corinthian believers abused speaking in tongues by doing it in a nonsensical way, uttering sounds with no distinction in the tones (v. 7) and giving forth uncertain sounds (v. 8). They also overused it by practicing it in any place, in any way, and in any situation. Hence, the apostle corrected them and restricted them from abusing and using excessively such a small gift of the least profit, that they might seek the greater gifts and abound in the edifying of the saints and the building up of the church.

refs.text_gb: 你们在自己的地，与欺压你们的敌人打仗，就要用号吹出大声，使你们在耶和华你们的神面前得蒙记念，也蒙拯救脱离仇敌。
refs.text_big5: 你們在自己的地，與欺壓你們的敵人打仗，就要用號吹出大聲，使你們在耶和華你們的神面前得蒙記念，也蒙拯救脫離仇敵。
refs.text_en: And when you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, so that you may be remembered before Jehovah your God and be saved from your enemies.

refs.text_gb: 你要大声喊叫，不留余力；要扬起声来好像吹角，向我百姓说明他们的过犯，向雅各家说明他们的罪。
refs.text_big5: 你要大聲喊叫，不留餘力；要揚起聲來好像吹角，向我百姓說明他們的過犯，向雅各家說明他們的罪。
refs.text_en: Cry loudly; do not hold back; / Raise your voice like a trumpet, / And declare to My people their transgression / And to the house of Jacob their sins.

refs.text_gb: 我的心肠啊，我的心肠啊，我翻腾绞痛。我的心哪！我的心在我里面呻吟；我不能静默不言；因为我的魂哪，你已经听见角声，听见打仗的呐喊。
refs.text_big5: 我的心腸阿，我的心腸阿，我翻騰絞痛。我的心哪！我的心在我裏面呻吟；我不能靜默不言；因為我的魂哪，你已經聽見角聲，聽見打仗的吶喊。
refs.text_en: My bowels, my bowels; I am writhing. / Oh, the walls of my heart! / My heart is moaning within me; / I cannot be silent; / For you hear, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, / The alarm of war.

refs.text_gb: 他见刀剑临到那地，就吹角警戒众民，
refs.text_big5: 他見刀劍臨到那地，就吹角警戒眾民，
refs.text_en: And when he sees the sword come upon the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people;

refs.text_big5: 凡聽見角聲不受警戒的，刀劍若來除滅了他，流他血的罪就必歸到他自己的頭上。

refs.text_gb: 他听见角声，不受警戒，流他血的罪必归到他自己的身上；他若受警戒，便是救了自己的性命。
refs.text_big5: 他聽見角聲，不受警戒，流他血的罪必歸到他自己的身上；他若受警戒，便是救了自己的性命。
refs.text_en: He heard the sound of the trumpet and ignored the warning; his own blood will be on him; whereas if he had taken warning, he would have delivered his soul.

refs.text_gb: 倘若守望的人见刀剑临到，却不吹角，以致民未受警戒，刀剑来除灭了他们中间的一个人，他虽然因自己的罪孽被除灭，我却要从守望的人手中追讨流他血的罪。

refs.text_en: But if the watchman sees the sword come and does not blow the trumpet and the people are not warned and the sword comes and takes someone away from them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman's hand.

verses.text_gb: 你们也是如此，既渴慕[Fn1][Cra]灵，就要为着[Fn2]召会的[Crb]建造，寻求得以[Fn3]超越。

verses.text_en: So also you, since you are zealous of spirits, seek that you may excel for the building up of the church.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们也是如此，既渴慕灵，就要为着召会的建造，寻求得以超越。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們也是如此，既渴慕靈，就要為著召會的建造，尋求得以超越。

footnotes.zh: 灵，原文，诸灵。使徒在此乃是说，你们也是如此，既渴慕诸灵……。这给我们看见，当日出身外邦的哥林多信徒，因着他们的背景，在他们属灵的追求上，将惟一的圣灵，和诸多的邪灵，混为一团，不清楚且没有充分的保持圣灵的惟一性。这由十二4所说“灵却是同一位”的话得到证明。使徒这话，不是认可他们这种混淆的追求，乃是根据他们这混淆的事实，劝他们在这混淆中要寻求超脱而超越。
footnotes.zh_big5: 靈，原文，諸靈。使徒在此乃是說，你們也是如此，既渴慕諸靈…。這給我們看見，當日出身外邦的哥林多信徒，因著他們的背景，在他們屬靈的追求上，將惟一的聖靈，和諸多的邪靈，混為一團，不清楚且沒有充分的保持聖靈的惟一性。這由十二4所說“靈卻是同一位”的話得到證明。使徒這話，不是認可他們這種混淆的追求，乃是根據他們這混淆的事實，勸他們在這混淆中要尋求超脫而超越。
footnotes.en: 14:12 1 spirits Here the apostle said, "So also you, since you are zealous of spirits." This shows that in their spiritual pursuings in those days, because of their background the Corinthian believers, who were Gentiles by birth, confused the unique Holy Spirit with the various evil spirits; they were not clear about nor did they adequately hold the uniqueness of the Holy Spirit. This is proved by the words but the same Spirit in 1 Cor. 12:4. The apostle's word here did not sanction their confused pursuings; rather, based on the fact of their confusion, he exhorted them to seek to transcend and thereby to excel in the midst of their confusion.

footnotes.zh: 使徒全心顾到召会的建造。他满有召会的感觉，完全以召会为中心，与那些以自我为中心的哥林多人，完全不同。他们在属灵恩赐上的难处，是由于他们为自己追求，不顾到召会的建造。在对付头六项为人生活范围里的难处时，使徒强调基督是神给我们惟一的分；在对付后五项神圣行政范围里的难处时，使徒强调召会是神给我们惟一的目标。哥林多人不仅缺少基督，也不认识召会。使徒完成的职事(西一25)，乃是由基督是神的奥秘(西二2)，和召会是基督的奥秘(弗三4)所组成的。哥林多人虽在使徒的职事之下，却失去这二者。他们很可怜的在自己里面，又瞎眼又无知。
footnotes.zh_big5: 使徒全心顧到召會的建造。他滿有召會的感覺，完全以召會為中心，與那些以自我為中心的哥林多人，完全不同。他們在屬靈恩賜上的難處，是由於他們為自己追求，不顧到召會的建造。在對付頭六項為人生活範圍裏的難處時，使徒強調基督是神給我們惟一的分；在對付後五項神聖行政範圍裏的難處時，使徒強調召會是神給我們惟一的目標。哥林多人不僅缺少基督，也不認識召會。使徒完成的職事，（西一25，）乃是由基督是神的奧祕，（西二2，）和召會是基督的奧祕（弗三4）所組成的。哥林多人雖在使徒的職事之下，卻失去這二者。他們很可憐的在自己裏面，又瞎眼又無知。
footnotes.en: 14:12 2 excel The Greek word denotes to become full, to abound, to overflow; it also denotes to excel. See note 1 Cor. 8:8 1 . According to the context of this verse, the word here does not denote to abound, to increase, but to excel and be extraordinary. The words since you are zealous of spirits in the first part of this verse indicate already that in their pursuing of spiritual gifts, the Corinthian believers were confusing the Holy Spirit with the evil spirits. The apostle considered that kind of confused pursuing very demeaning, to the extent that the Corinthian believers might even have been considered barbarians. Therefore, the apostle exhorted them not to pursue some indiscernible, intermixed spiritual things for their own enjoyment and display, but to pursue so as to excel, that is, go beyond the low pursuing, for the building up of the church.

footnotes.zh: 原文是一个字，指充盈、满溢、洋溢，也指超越。见八8注1。照本节上下文看，这字在此不是指满溢增多，乃是指超越不凡。本节前文所说“你们……既渴慕诸灵，”已经指明当日的哥林多信徒，把圣灵和邪灵混在一起，而追求属灵的恩赐。那种混淆的追求，在使徒看，甚为低下，甚至会给人看为化外人。所以使徒劝他们，不要为着自己的享受或显扬，追求一些未经分辨、混淆一团的属灵事物，乃要为着建造召会追求超越，就是超过那些低下的追求。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文是一個字，指充盈、滿溢、洋溢，也指超越。見八8註1。照本節上下文看，這字在此不是指滿溢增多，乃是指超越不凡。本節前文所說“你們…既渴慕諸靈，”已經指明當日的哥林多信徒，把聖靈和邪靈混在一起，而追求屬靈的恩賜。那種混淆的追求，在使徒看，甚為低下，甚至會給人看為化外人。所以使徒勸他們，不要為著自己的享受或顯揚，追求一些未經分辨、混淆一團的屬靈事物，乃要為著建造召會追求超越，就是超過那些低下的追求。
footnotes.en: 14:12 3 building The apostle was fully occupied with the consideration of building up the church. He was fully church-conscious and church-centered, altogether different from the self-centered Corinthians. Their problem with spiritual gifts was due to their self-seeking, their not caring for the building up of the church. In dealing with the first six problems, which were in the realm of human life, the apostle stressed Christ as God's unique portion to us; in dealing with the last five problems, which were in the realm of the divine administration, he emphasized the church as God's unique goal for us. The Corinthians were not only void of Christ but also ignorant of the church. The apostle's completing ministry (Col. 1:25) is composed of Christ as the mystery of God (Col. 2:2) and the church as the mystery of Christ (Eph. 3:4). However, the Corinthians missed both, even though they were under the apostle's ministry. They were pitifully in themselves, blind and ignorant.

footnotes.en: 14:14 1 spirit; mind For our spirit to be used and exercised in prayer is surely healthy for our spiritual life. But for our mind to be unfruitful and unused is absolutely unhealthy. In praying to the Lord, we must exercise our regenerated spirit and our renewed mind. Our mind should be set on our spirit (Rom. 8:6) and should never be detached from it, even in our daily walk, needless to say in our prayer. footnotes.en: 14:15 1 also This implies that the apostle encouraged the receivers of his letter to pray not only in an unknown tongue but also with clear and understandable words.

footnotes.zh: 这不是说，只用心思，一点不用灵。在弗六18，使徒嘱咐我们要时时在灵里祷告。祷告就是敬拜，敬拜就当在灵里(约四24)。当我们用灵祷告，不用人所不懂的方言，而用人明白的话语，我们就自然而然的用心思解释、表达灵的思想。使徒在这里的意思是说，在召会的聚会中，为了全体与会者的益处，我们应当用心思，用人所理解的话祷告(19)，以发表我们灵里的负担。在召会的聚会中，我们的祷告不仅该让主听见，蒙祂应允，也该让全体与会者懂得，叫他们得益处。为着这目的，我们在公众的祷告里，也应该学习用心思，就像用灵一样，训练心思与灵合作，甚至与灵成为一，使灵能成为心思的灵(弗四23)。
footnotes.en: 14:15 2 with This does not mean to pray with the mind only and not at all with the spirit. In Eph. 6:18 the apostle charged us to pray at every time in spirit. Prayer is worship, which should be in spirit (John 4:24). When we pray with the spirit, not in an unknown tongue but in understandable words, our mind is automatically used to interpret and express the thought of the spirit. What the apostle meant here is that in the church meeting, for the profit of all the attendants, we should pray with our mind in intelligible words (v. 19) to express the burden in our spirit. In a church meeting our prayer not only should be heard by the Lord for His answer but also should be intelligible to all the attendants for their profit. For this purpose we should learn to use our mind in public prayer just as we use our spirit, training our mind to cooperate with our spirit, even to be one with our spirit, that the spirit may become the spirit of our mind (Eph. 4:23).

refs.text_big5: 耶和華以色列的神，從亙古直到永遠，是當受頌讚的。願眾民都說，阿們。阿利路亞。
refs.text_en: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, / From eternity to eternity. / And let all the people say, Amen. / Hallelujah.

refs.text_gb: 申言者耶利米说，阿们！愿耶和华如此行，愿耶和华坚立你所预言的话，将耶和华殿中的器皿，和一切被迁徙的人，从巴比伦带回这地方。
refs.text_big5: 申言者耶利米說，阿們！願耶和華如此行，願耶和華堅立你所豫言的話，將耶和華殿中的器皿，和一切被遷徙的人，從巴比倫帶回這地方。
refs.text_en: And the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen! May Jehovah do so. May Jehovah establish your words which you have prophesied and bring back the vessels of the house of Jehovah and all the exiles from Babylon to this place.

refs.text_gb: 因为神的应许，不论有多少，在基督里都是是的，所以借着祂，对神也都是阿们的，好叫荣耀借着我们归与神。
refs.text_big5: 因為神的應許，不論有多少，在基督裏都是是的，所以藉著祂，對神也都是阿們的，好叫榮耀藉著我們歸與神。
refs.text_en: For as many promises of God as there are, in Him is the Yes; therefore also through Him is the Amen to God, for glory through us to God.

refs.text_gb: 四活物就说，阿们。众长老也俯伏敬拜。
refs.text_big5: 四活物就說，阿們。眾長老也俯伏敬拜。
refs.text_en: And the four living creatures said, Amen. And the elders fell down and worshipped.

refs.text_gb: 阿们。愿颂赞、荣耀、智慧、感谢、尊贵、能力、力量，都归与我们的神，直到永永远远。阿们。
refs.text_big5: 阿們。願頌讚、榮耀、智慧、感謝、尊貴、能力、力量，都歸與我們的神，直到永永遠遠。阿們。
refs.text_en: Saying, Amen. The blessing and the glory and the wisdom and the thanks and the honor and the power and the strength be to our God forever and ever. Amen.

refs.text_gb: 那二十四位长老与四活物，就俯伏敬拜那坐宝座的神，说，阿们，阿利路亚！
refs.text_big5: 那二十四位長老與四活物，就俯伏敬拜那坐寶座的神，說，阿們，阿利路亞！
refs.text_en: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped God, who sits upon the throne, saying, Amen, Hallelujah!

refs.text_gb: 有人制造耶和华所憎恶的雕像或铸像，就是工匠的手所作的，在暗中设立，那人必受咒诅。百姓都要答应说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 有人製造耶和華所憎惡的雕像或鑄像，就是工匠的手所作的，在暗中設立，那人必受咒詛。百姓都要答應說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is the man who makes an idol or a molten image, an abomination to Jehovah, the work of the craftsman's hands, and puts it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 轻慢父母的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 輕慢父母的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 挪移邻舍地界的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 挪移鄰舍地界的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who moves his neighbor's boundary marker. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 使瞎子走错路的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 使瞎子走錯路的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who leads astray a blind man on the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 向寄居的和孤儿寡妇屈枉公理的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 向寄居的和孤兒寡婦屈枉公理的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who distorts justice due a sojourner, an orphan, or a widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 与父亲的妻子行淫的，必受咒诅，因为掀开他父亲的衣边。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 與父親的妻子行淫的，必受咒詛，因為掀開他父親的衣邊。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who lies with his father's wife, for he uncovers the skirt of his father's garment. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 与兽淫合的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 與獸淫合的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who lies with any animal. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 与异母同父，或异父同母的姊妹行淫的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 與異母同父，或異父同母的姊妹行淫的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father's daughter or his mother's daughter. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 与岳母行淫的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 與岳母行淫的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 暗中杀害邻舍的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 暗中殺害鄰舍的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who slays his neighbor secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 受贿赂杀害人，流无辜人之血的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 受賄賂殺害人，流無辜人之血的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who takes payment to slay someone of innocent blood. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 不坚守遵行这律法言语的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 不堅守遵行這律法言語的，必受咒詛。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who does not confirm the words of this law by doing them. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.text_gb: 你固然感谢得好，无奈别人得不着[Fn1][Cra]建造。
verses.text_big5: 你固然感謝得好，無奈別人得不著[Fn1][Cra]建造。
verses.text_en: For you give thanks well, but the other is not built up.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你固然感谢得好，无奈别人得不着建造。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你固然感謝得好，無奈別人得不著建造。

footnotes.zh: 这指明在召会的聚会中，不仅我们的申言和教导该建造别人，连我们向主的祷告和感谢，也该建造别人。这表明使徒何等关心召会与众圣徒的建造。他在本节的话，不只是改正，也是嘱咐。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明在召會的聚會中，不僅我們的申言和教導該建造別人，連我們向主的禱告和感謝，也該建造別人。這表明使徒何等關心召會與眾聖徒的建造。他在本節的話，不只是改正，也是囑咐。
footnotes.en: 14:17 1 built This indicates that not only our prophesying and teaching in the church meetings but also our prayers and thanks to the Lord should build up others. This shows how much the apostle was concerned with the building up of the church and the saints.

refs.text_gb: 但那申言的，是对人讲说建造、勉励和安慰。
refs.text_big5: 但那申言的，是對人講說建造、勉勵和安慰。
refs.text_en: But he who prophesies speaks building up and encouragement and consolation to men.

refs.text_gb: 那说方言的，是建造自己，但那申言的，乃是建造召会。
refs.text_big5: 那說方言的，是建造自己，但那申言的，乃是建造召會。
refs.text_en: He who speaks in a tongue builds up himself, but he who prophesies builds up the church.

refs.text_gb: 我愿意你们都说方言，但我更愿意你们申言；说方言的，若不翻出来，使召会得建造，那申言的，就比他强了。
refs.text_big5: 我願意你們都說方言，但我更願意你們申言；說方言的，若不繙出來，使召會得建造，那申言的，就比他強了。
refs.text_en: I desire that you all speak in tongues, but especially that you would prophesy; and greater is he who prophesies than he who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, that the church may receive building up.

verses.text_gb: 我感谢神，我说方言比你们众人还多，
verses.text_big5: 我感謝神，我說方言比你們眾人還多，
verses.text_en: I thank God, I speak in tongues more than all of you,
verses.text_gb_plain: 我感谢神，我说方言比你们众人还多，
verses.text_big5_plain: 我感謝神，我說方言比你們眾人還多，

verses.text_gb: 但在召会中，我宁愿[Fn1]用我的心思[Cra]说[Fn2]五句话，可以教导人，强如用方言说万句话。
verses.text_big5: 但在召會中，我寧願[Fn1]用我的心思[Cra]說[Fn2]五句話，可以教導人，強如用方言說萬句話。
verses.text_en: But in the church I would rather speak five words with my mind, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in a tongue.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但在召会中，我宁愿用我的心思说五句话，可以教导人，强如用方言说万句话。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但在召會中，我寧願用我的心思說五句話，可以教導人，強如用方言說萬句話。

footnotes.en: 14:19 1 five; ten This shows how much speaking in intelligible words is needed in the church meeting for the building up of the church, and that speaking in tongues is not needed at all.

footnotes.zh: 这表明在召会的聚会中，为着召会的建造，何等需要说人所理解的话，一点不需要说方言。
footnotes.en: 14:19 2 with See note 1 Cor. 14:15 2 .

refs.text_gb: 我愿意你们都说方言，但我更愿意你们申言；说方言的，若不翻出来，使召会得建造，那申言的，就比他强了。
refs.text_big5: 我願意你們都說方言，但我更願意你們申言；說方言的，若不繙出來，使召會得建造，那申言的，就比他強了。
refs.text_en: I desire that you all speak in tongues, but especially that you would prophesy; and greater is he who prophesies than he who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, that the church may receive building up.

refs.text_gb: 你们也是如此，既渴慕灵，就要为着召会的建造，寻求得以超越。
refs.text_big5: 你們也是如此，既渴慕靈，就要為著召會的建造，尋求得以超越。
refs.text_en: So also you, since you are zealous of spirits, seek that you may excel for the building up of the church.

refs.text_gb: 但你们要切慕那更大的恩赐。我还要把极超越的路指示你们。
refs.text_big5: 但你們要切慕那更大的恩賜。我還要把極超越的路指示你們。
refs.text_en: But earnestly desire the greater gifts. And moreover I show to you a most excellent way.

verses.text_gb: 弟兄们，在[Fn1]领悟上不要作[Fn2][Cra]小孩子，但在[Crb]恶事上要作[Crc]婴孩，在领悟上却要[Fn3][Crd]成熟。
verses.text_big5: 弟兄們，在[Fn1]領悟上不要作[Fn2][Cra]小孩子，但在[Crb]惡事上要作[Crc]嬰孩，在領悟上卻要[Fn3][Crd]成熟。
verses.text_en: Brothers, do not be children in your understanding, but in malice be babes and in your understanding be full-grown.
verses.text_gb_plain: 弟兄们，在领悟上不要作小孩子，但在恶事上要作婴孩，在领悟上却要成熟。
verses.text_big5_plain: 弟兄們，在領悟上不要作小孩子，但在惡事上要作嬰孩，在領悟上卻要成熟。

footnotes.zh: 或，思想，推理，心思。原文这辞与15、19节的心思不同。这辞“强调与狂热的区别。”(Vincent，文生。)这是说到哥林多的信徒，对说方言的领悟和思想。他们狂热于说方言，因此对这事的领悟像小孩子，不像成熟的信徒，能合式的运用心思。使徒劝他们要在领悟上长大成熟，就是在说方言的事上像他一样(19)，能合式的运用心思。
footnotes.en: 14:20 1 children The Corinthian believers were not only infants in life (1 Cor. 3:1) but also children in understanding. They needed to grow both in life and in their mind's understanding. All the apostle's efforts to deal with their problems were for this purpose, that they might mature in every way.

footnotes.zh: 哥林多的信徒不仅在生命上是婴孩(三1)，在领悟上也是小孩子。他们需要在生命里长大，也需要在心思的领悟上长大。使徒对付他们的难处，就是为这目的，使他们在各方面都能成熟。
footnotes.zh_big5: 哥林多的信徒不僅在生命上是嬰孩，（三1，）在領悟上也是小孩子。他們需要在生命裏長大，也需要在心思的領悟上長大。使徒對付他們的難處，就是為這目的，使他們在各方面都能成熟。
footnotes.en: 14:20 2 understanding Or, thinking, reasoning, mind. In Greek the word is different from the word for mind in vv. 15, 19, which "emphasizes the distinction from ecstasy" (Vincent). This is in regard to the Corinthian believers' understanding and thinking concerning speaking in tongues. They were ecstatic in this practice and thus were childish in their understanding concerning it, not using their mind properly as a mature believer should. The apostle advised them to grow and become full-grown in their understanding, that is, in the proper use of their mind, as he had done (v. 19), in the matter of tongue-speaking.

footnotes.zh: 幼稚的哥林多信徒需要在领悟上成熟，使他们能认识以下21～25节所说的事。
footnotes.zh_big5: 幼稚的哥林多信徒需要在領悟上成熟，使他們能認識以下21～25節所說的事。
footnotes.en: 14:20 3 full The childish Corinthian believers needed to become full-grown in their understanding that they might be able to know the things that are mentioned in vv. 21-25.

refs.text_gb: 我作孩童的时候，说话像孩童，思想像孩童，推究像孩童，既已成人，就把孩童的事废掉了。
refs.text_big5: 我作孩童的時候，說話像孩童，思想像孩童，推究像孩童，既已成人，就把孩童的事廢掉了。
refs.text_en: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I thought as a child, I reasoned as a child; since I have become a man, I have done away with childish things.

refs.text_gb: 使我们不再作小孩子，为波浪漂来漂去，并为一切教训之风所摇荡，这教训是在于人的欺骗手法，在于将人引入错谬系统的诡诈作为；
refs.text_big5: 使我們不再作小孩子，為波浪漂來漂去，並為一切教訓之風所搖蕩，這教訓是在於人的欺騙手法，在於將人引入錯謬系統的詭詐作為；
refs.text_en: That we may be no longer little children tossed by waves and carried about by every wind of teaching in the sleight of men, in craftiness with a view to a system of error,

refs.text_gb: 按时间说，你们该作教师；可是你们还需要有人将神谕言开端的要纲教导你们；并且成了那必须用奶，不能吃干粮的人。
refs.text_big5: 按時間說，你們該作教師；可是你們還需要有人將神諭言開端的要綱教導你們；並且成了那必須用奶，不能喫乾糧的人。
refs.text_en: For when because of the time you ought to be teachers, you have need again for someone to teach you what the rudiments of the beginning of the oracles of God are and have become those who have need of milk and not of solid food.

refs.text_gb: 凡只能享用奶的，对公义的话都是没有经验的，因为他是婴孩；
refs.text_big5: 凡只能享用奶的，對公義的話都是沒有經驗的，因為他是嬰孩；
refs.text_en: For everyone who partakes of milk is inexperienced in the word of righteousness, for he is an infant;

refs.text_gb: 你们的顺从已经传于众人，所以我为你们欢乐，不过我还愿意你们在善上智慧，在恶上单纯。
refs.text_big5: 你們的順從已經傳於眾人，所以我為你們歡樂，不過我還願意你們在善上智慧，在惡上單純。
refs.text_en: For the report of your obedience has reached to all; therefore I rejoice over you, but I want you to be wise as to what is good and guileless as to what is evil.

crossrefs.label: c
crossrefs.raw: 诗一三一2，太十一25，十八3，彼前二2

refs.text_gb: 我使我的魂平稳安静，好像断过奶的孩子在他母亲怀中；我的魂在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。
refs.text_big5: 我使我的魂平穩安靜，好像斷過奶的孩子在他母親懷中；我的魂在我裏面真像斷過奶的孩子。
refs.text_en: Surely I have calmed / And quieted my soul, / Like a weaned child with its mother; / Like a weaned child is my soul within me.

refs.text_gb: 那时，耶稣回答说，父啊，天地的主，我颂扬你，因为你将这些事，向智慧通达人藏起来，向婴孩却启示出来。
refs.text_big5: 那時，耶穌回答說，父阿，天地的主，我頌揚你，因為你將這些事，向智慧通達人藏起來，向嬰孩卻啟示出來。
refs.text_en: At that time Jesus answered and said, I extol You, Father, Lord of heaven and of earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and intelligent and have revealed them to infants.

refs.text_gb: 我实在告诉你们，你们若不回转，变成像小孩子一样，绝不能进诸天的国。
refs.text_big5: 我實在告訴你們，你們若不回轉，變成像小孩子一樣，絕不能進諸天的國。
refs.text_en: And said, Truly I say to you, Unless you turn and become like little children, you shall by no means enter into the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 像才生的婴孩一样，切慕那纯净的话奶，叫你们靠此长大，以致得救；
refs.text_big5: 像纔生的嬰孩一樣，切慕那純淨的話奶，叫你們靠此長大，以致得救；
refs.text_en: As newborn babes, long for the guileless milk of the word in order that by it you may grow unto salvation,

refs.text_gb: 直到我们众人都达到了信仰上并对神儿子之完全认识上的一，达到了长成的人，达到了基督丰满之身材的度量，
refs.text_big5: 直到我們眾人都達到了信仰上並對神兒子之完全認識上的一，達到了長成的人，達到了基督豐滿之身材的度量，
refs.text_en: Until we all arrive at the oneness of the faith and of the full knowledge of the Son of God, at a full-grown man, at the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

refs.text_gb: 只有长成的人，才能吃干粮，他们的官能因习用而受了操练，就能分辨好坏了。
refs.text_big5: 只有長成的人，纔能喫乾糧，他們的官能因習用而受了操練，就能分辨好壞了。
refs.text_en: But solid food is for the full-grown, who because of practice have their faculties exercised for discriminating between both good and evil.

refs.text_gb: 我们宣扬祂，是用全般的智慧警戒各人，教导各人，好将各人在基督里成熟地献上；
refs.text_big5: 我們宣揚祂，是用全般的智慧警戒各人，教導各人，好將各人在基督裏成熟的獻上；
refs.text_en: Whom we announce, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom that we may present every man full-grown in Christ;

verses.text_gb: [Fn1][Cra]律法上记着：“[Fn2][Crb]主说，我要用异邦人的舌头，和异邦人的嘴唇，向这百姓说话；虽然如此，他们还是不听从我。”
verses.text_big5: [Fn1][Cra]律法上記著：“[Fn2][Crb]主說，我要用異邦人的舌頭，和異邦人的嘴脣，向這百姓說話；雖然如此，他們還是不聽從我。”
verses.text_en: In the law it is written, "By those of other tongues and with the lips of others I will speak to this people; even so they will not listen to Me, says the Lord."

footnotes.en: 14:21 1 law Referring to the Old Testament. See note 1 Cor. 14:34 3 .

footnotes.zh: 这话在赛二八9～13，指明用异邦人的舌头说话，对以色列人乃是惩治，因为他们不信神那可理解的话。因此，使徒引用这话，含示哥林多人未曾正确的接受神借使徒所传可理解的启示。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這話在賽二八9～13，指明用異邦人的舌頭說話，對以色列人乃是懲治，因為他們不信神那可理解的話。因此，使徒引用這話，含示哥林多人未曾正確的接受神藉使徒所傳可理解的啟示。
footnotes.en: 14:21 2 By This word in Isa. 28:9-13 indicates that the speaking in strange tongues was a chastisement to the children of Israel because they did not believe the intelligible word of God. Hence, the apostle's quoting of this word implies that the Corinthians had not properly received the intelligible revelation of God through the apostles.

footnotes.en: 14:22 1 sign So then at the beginning of this verse indicates that according to the word in v. 21 quoted from Isa. 28, tongues are for a negative sign to the unbelievers, signifying their poor condition of unbelief. footnotes.zh: “有”字，在本节中提了五次，原文是一个广泛使用，有多种意义的字，以下是其中主要的三种：(一)持有，占有，守住(某物)；(二)有(某物)作为享受；(三)有作某事的方法或能力。头二种应当适用于本节所列举五件事的前三件，第三种应当适用于后二件，说方言和翻方言。这指明我们来到召会的聚会中，该有一些出于主的东西与别人分享：或有诗歌赞美主；或有(教师的)教训，将基督的丰富供应人，好造就并滋养人；或有申言者的启示(30)，给人看见神永远定旨的异象，就是关于基督是神的奥秘，以及召会是基督的奥秘；或有方言，给不信的人作表记(22)，使他们认识并接受基督；或有翻出来的话，使论到基督和祂身体的方言，成为人明白的话。我们来聚会之前，应当对主有经历，对主的话有享受，并且在祷告中和主有交通，使我们有前文所说那些从主而来，并出于主的东西，借着这些，我们就能为聚会预备自己。到了会中，我们就不需要，也不该等候灵感，乃该运用灵，使用受过训练的心思尽功用，摆上我们所预备的，使主得着荣耀和满足，并使与会者得着益处，就是得着光照、滋养和建造。 这就像古时的住棚节，以色列人将美地的出产，就是他们经营那地所得的收获，带来过节献给主，好在与主的交通并彼此的交通中，让主有享受，也彼此在主面前有享受。我们必须经营基督，就是我们的美地，使我们从祂的丰富收获出产，带到召会的聚会中献上。这样，召会的聚会，就是展览基督的丰富，也是全体与会者在神面前并同着神，彼此分享基督，使众圣徒与召会得着建造。 按照本书所强调并着重的，本节所列的五件事，都该集中于神的中心，基督，作我们的分；以及神的目标，召会，作我们的目的。诗歌该是赞美神将基督赐给我们，作我们日常生活和召会生活的智慧与能力。教师的教训和申言者的启示，该把基督与召会，就是基督的身体，教导并供应人。方言和翻出来的话，也该以基督与召会为中心和内容。凡强调在基督与召会之外的东西，都会使召会紊乱，并偏离神新约经纶的中心路线，把召会弄成和在哥林多的召会一样。
footnotes.zh_big5: “有”字，在本節中題了五次，原文是一個廣泛使用，有多種意義的字，以下是其中主要的三種：(一)持有，佔有，守住（某物）；(二)有（某物）作為享受；(三)有作某事的方法或能力。頭二種應當適用於本節所列舉五件事的前三件，第三種應當適用於後二件，說方言和繙方言。這指明我們來到召會的聚會中，該有一些出於主的東西與別人分享：或有詩歌讚美主；或有（教師的）教訓，將基督的豐富供應人，好造就並滋養人；或有申言者的啟示，（30，）給人看見神永遠定旨的異象，就是關於基督是神的奧祕，以及召會是基督的奧祕；或有方言，給不信的人作表記，（22，）使他們認識並接受基督；或有繙出來的話，使論到基督和祂身體的方言，成為人明白的話。我們來聚會之前，應當對主有經歷，對主的話有享受，並且在禱告中和主有交通，使我們有前文所說那些從主而來，並出於主的東西，藉著這些，我們就能為聚會豫備自己。到了會中，我們就不需要，也不該等候靈感，乃該運用靈，使用受過訓練的心思盡功用，擺上我們所豫備的，使主得著榮耀和滿足，並使與會者得著益處，就是得著光照、滋養和建造。ˍ這就像古時的住棚節，以色列人將美地的出產，就是他們經營那地所得的收穫，帶來過節獻給主，好在與主的交通並彼此的交通中，讓主有享受，也彼此在主面前有享受。我們必須經營基督，就是我們的美地，使我們從祂的豐富收穫出產，帶到召會的聚會中獻上。這樣，召會的聚會，就是展覽基督的豐富，也是全體與會者在神面前並同著神，彼此分享基督，使眾聖徒與召會得著建造。ˍ按照本書所強調並著重的，本節所列的五件事，都該集中於神的中心，基督，作我們的分；以及神的目標，召會，作我們的目的。詩歌該是讚美神將基督賜給我們，作我們日常生活和召會生活的智慧與能力。教師的教訓和申言者的啟示，該把基督與召會，就是基督的身體，教導並供應人。方言和繙出來的話，也該以基督與召會為中心和內容。凡強調在基督與召會之外的東西，都會使召會紊亂，並偏離神新約經綸的中心路線，把召會弄成和在哥林多的召會一樣。
footnotes.en: 14:26 1 has Has, occurring five times in this verse, is a widely used Greek word, a word with many meanings, of which the following three are the main ones: 1) to hold, to possess, to keep (a certain thing); 2) to have (a certain thing) for enjoyment; 3) to have the means or power to do a certain thing. The first two meanings should be applied to the first three of the five items listed in this verse, and the third to the last two — a tongue and an interpretation of a tongue. This indicates that when we come to the church meeting, we should have something of the Lord to share with others, whether a psalm to praise the Lord, a teaching (of the teacher) to minister the riches of Christ to edify and nourish others, a revelation (of the prophet, v. 30) to give visions of God's eternal purpose concerning Christ as God's mystery and the church as Christ's mystery, a tongue for a sign to the unbelievers (v. 22) that they may know and accept Christ, or an interpretation to make a tongue concerning Christ and His Body understandable. Before coming to the meeting, we should prepare ourselves for the meeting with such things from the Lord and of the Lord, either through our experience of Him or through our enjoyment of His word and fellowship with Him in prayer. After coming into the meeting, we need not wait, and should not wait, for inspiration; we should exercise our spirit and use our trained mind to function in presenting what we have prepared to the Lord for His glory and satisfaction and to the attendants for their benefit — their enlightenment, nourishment, and building up. This is like the Feast of Tabernacles in ancient times. The children of Israel brought the produce of the good land, which they had reaped from their labor on the land, to the feast and offered it to the Lord for His enjoyment and for their mutual participation in fellowship with the Lord and with one another. We must labor on Christ, our good land, that we may reap some produce of His riches to bring to the church meeting and offer. Thus the meeting will be an exhibition of Christ in His riches and will be a mutual enjoyment of Christ shared by all the attendants before God and with God for the building up of the saints and the church. According to the stress and emphasis of this Epistle, all five items listed in this verse should focus on Christ as God's center for our portion and the church as God's goal for our aim. The psalm should be the praise to God for giving Christ as wisdom and power to us for our daily life and church life. The teaching from a teacher and the revelation from a prophet should teach and minister Christ and the church, which is the Body of Christ, to people. A tongue and its interpretation also should have Christ and the church as their center and content. Any stress on things other than Christ and the church will bring confusion to the church and distract it from the central lane of God's New Testament economy, making it like the church in Corinth.

footnotes.zh: 或，造就。我们在召会的聚会中无论作什么，都必须是为着建造众圣徒和召会。在聚会中展览基督、享受基督，以建造基督的身体，必须是我们惟一的目的与目标。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，造就。我們在召會的聚會中無論作甚麼，都必須是為著建造眾聖徒和召會。在聚會中展覽基督、享受基督，以建造基督的身體，必須是我們惟一的目的與目標。
footnotes.en: 14:26 2 building Or, edification. Whatever we do in the church meeting must be for the building up of the saints and the church. To exhibit Christ and enjoy Him in the meetings for the building up of His Body must be our unique purpose and goal.

refs.text_gb: 所以若全召会聚在一处的时候，众人都说方言，有不通方言的，或是不信的人进来，岂不说你们癫狂了么？
refs.text_big5: 所以若全召會聚在一處的時候，眾人都說方言，有不通方言的，或是不信的人進來，豈不說你們癲狂了麼？
refs.text_en: If therefore the whole church comes together in one place, and all speak in tongues, and some unlearned in tongues or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are insane?

refs.text_gb: 用诗章、颂辞、灵歌，彼此对说，从心中向主歌唱、颂咏，
refs.text_big5: 用詩章、頌辭、靈歌，彼此對說，從心中向主歌唱、頌詠，
refs.text_en: Speaking to one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and psalming with your heart to the Lord,

refs.text_gb: 当用各样的智慧，让基督的话丰丰富富地住在你们里面，用诗章、颂辞、灵歌，彼此教导，互相劝戒，心被恩感歌颂神；
refs.text_big5: 當用各樣的智慧，讓基督的話豐豐富富的住在你們裏面，用詩章、頌辭、靈歌，彼此教導，互相勸戒，心被恩感歌頌神；
refs.text_en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing one another with psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to God.

refs.text_gb: 你们中间有受苦的么？他该祷告。有愉快的么？他该歌颂。
refs.text_big5: 你們中間有受苦的麼？他該禱告。有愉快的麼？他該歌頌。
refs.text_en: Does anyone among you suffer evil? Let him pray. Is anyone cheerful? Let him sing praise.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，我到你们那里去，若只说方言，与你们有什么益处？除非我用启示，或知识，或预言，或教训，对你们讲说。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，我到你們那裏去，若只說方言，與你們有甚麼益處？除非我用啟示，或知識，或豫言，或教訓，對你們講說。
refs.text_en: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, what will I profit you, unless I speak to you either in revelation or in knowledge or in prophecy or in teaching?

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，我到你们那里去，若只说方言，与你们有什么益处？除非我用启示，或知识，或预言，或教训，对你们讲说。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，我到你們那裏去，若只說方言，與你們有甚麼益處？除非我用啟示，或知識，或豫言，或教訓，對你們講說。
refs.text_en: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, what will I profit you, unless I speak to you either in revelation or in knowledge or in prophecy or in teaching?

refs.text_gb: 另有一人能行异能，另有一人能申言，另有一人能辨别诸灵，另有别人能说各种方言，另有一人能翻方言。
refs.text_big5: 另有一人能行異能，另有一人能申言，另有一人能辨別諸靈，另有別人能說各種方言，另有一人能繙方言。
refs.text_en: And to another operations of works of power, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits; to a different one various kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.

refs.text_gb: 另有一人能行异能，另有一人能申言，另有一人能辨别诸灵，另有别人能说各种方言，另有一人能翻方言。
refs.text_big5: 另有一人能行異能，另有一人能申言，另有一人能辨別諸靈，另有別人能說各種方言，另有一人能繙方言。
refs.text_en: And to another operations of works of power, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits; to a different one various kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.

refs.text_gb: 我愿意你们都说方言，但我更愿意你们申言；说方言的，若不翻出来，使召会得建造，那申言的，就比他强了。
refs.text_big5: 我願意你們都說方言，但我更願意你們申言；說方言的，若不繙出來，使召會得建造，那申言的，就比他強了。
refs.text_en: I desire that you all speak in tongues, but especially that you would prophesy; and greater is he who prophesies than he who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, that the church may receive building up.

refs.text_gb: 所以那说方言的，就当祷告，使他能翻出来。
refs.text_big5: 所以那說方言的，就當禱告，使他能繙出來。
refs.text_en: Therefore let him who speaks in a tongue pray that he may interpret.

refs.text_gb: 若有人说方言，只好两个人，至多三个人，且要轮流着说，也要有一个人翻出来；
refs.text_big5: 若有人說方言，只好兩個人，至多三個人，且要輪流著說，也要有一個人繙出來；
refs.text_en: If anyone speaks in a tongue, it should be by two, or at the most three, and in turn, and one should interpret;

refs.text_gb: 关于祭偶像之物，我们晓得我们都有知识。知识是叫人自高自大，唯有爱建造人。
refs.text_big5: 關於祭偶像之物，我們曉得我們都有知識。知識是叫人自高自大，惟有愛建造人。
refs.text_en: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

refs.text_gb: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都建造人。
refs.text_big5: 凡事都可行，但不都有益處；凡事都可行，但不都建造人。
refs.text_en: All things are lawful, but not all things are profitable; all things are lawful, but not all things build up.

refs.text_gb: 你们一向以为我们是向你们分诉，我们乃是在基督里当着神面前说话。亲爱的，一切的事都是为建造你们。
refs.text_big5: 你們一向以為我們是向你們分訴，我們乃是在基督裏當著神面前說話。親愛的，一切的事都是為建造你們。
refs.text_en: All this time you have been thinking that we are defending ourselves to you. Before God in Christ we speak; but all things, beloved, are for your building up.

refs.text_gb: 所以我不在的时候，写这些事，好叫我同在的时候，不必照着主所赐给我的权柄，严厉的待你们；这权柄是为着建造人，并不是为着拆毁人。
refs.text_big5: 所以我不在的時候，寫這些事，好叫我同在的時候，不必照著主所賜給我的權柄，嚴厲的待你們；這權柄是為著建造人，並不是為著拆毀人。
refs.text_en: Therefore I write these things while being absent in order that when present I would not have to use severity, according to the authority which the Lord has given me for building up and not for overthrowing.

refs.text_gb: 败坏的话一句都不可出口，只要按需要说建造人的好话，好将恩典供给听见的人。
refs.text_big5: 敗壞的話一句都不可出口，只要按需要說建造人的好話，好將恩典供給聽見的人。
refs.text_en: Let no corrupt word proceed out of your mouth, but only that which is good for building up, according to the need, that it may give grace to those who hear.

refs.text_gb: 他若不听，你就另带一两个人同去，要凭两三个见证人的口，句句都可定准。

refs.text_en: But if he does not hear you, take with you one or two more, that by the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

refs.text_en: And to another operations of works of power, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits; to a different one various kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.

refs.text_gb: 耳朵岂不试验言语，正如上膛品尝食物么？
refs.text_big5: 耳朵豈不試驗言語，正如上膛品嘗食物麼？
refs.text_en: Does not the ear try words / Even as the palate tastes food for itself?

refs.text_gb: 亲爱的，一切的灵，你们不可都信，总要试证那些灵是出于神的不是；因为有许多假申言者已经出来，进到世界里了。
refs.text_big5: 親愛的，一切的靈，你們不可都信，總要試證那些靈是出於神的不是；因為有許多假申言者已經出來，進到世界裏了。
refs.text_en: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but prove the spirits whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

verses.text_gb: 但若在座的，另有人得了启示，那先说话的就当静默。
verses.text_big5: 但若在座的，另有人得了啟示，那先說話的就當靜默。
verses.text_en: But if something is revealed to another sitting by, the first should be silent.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但若在座的，另有人得了启示，那先说话的就当静默。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但若在座的，另有人得了啟示，那先說話的就當靜默。

verses.text_gb: 因为[Fn1]你们[Cra]都能一个一个地申言，为要使众人有学习，使众人得[Fn2]勉励。
verses.text_big5: 因為[Fn1]你們[Cra]都能一個一個的申言，為要使眾人有學習，使眾人得[Fn2]勉勵。
verses.text_en: For you can all prophesy one by one that all may learn and all may be encouraged.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为你们都能一个一个地申言，为要使众人有学习，使众人得勉励。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為你們都能一個一個的申言，為要使眾人有學習，使眾人得勉勵。

footnotes.zh: 神愿意每一位信徒都能申言，就是为祂说话，并说出祂(1下，参民十一29)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神願意每一位信徒都能申言，就是為祂說話，並說出祂。（1下，參民十一29。）
footnotes.en: 14:31 1 you God desires that each of the believers prophesy, that is, speak for and speak forth Him (v. 1b; cf. Num. 11:29).

footnotes.zh: 或，安慰。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，安慰。
footnotes.en: 14:31 2 encouraged Or, comforted.

refs.text_gb: 但若众人都申言，有不信的，或是不通方言的人进来，他就被众人劝服，被众人审明了；
refs.text_big5: 但若眾人都申言，有不信的，或是不通方言的人進來，他就被眾人勸服，被眾人審明了；
refs.text_en: But if all prophesy and some unbeliever or unlearned person enters, he is convicted by all, he is examined by all;

verses.text_gb: 并且[Fn1]申言者的[Cra]灵，是[Crb]服从申言者的，
verses.text_big5: 並且[Fn1]申言者的[Cra]靈，是[Crb]服從申言者的，
verses.text_en: And the spirits of prophets are subject to prophets;
verses.text_gb_plain: 并且申言者的灵，是服从申言者的，
verses.text_big5_plain: 並且申言者的靈，是服從申言者的，

footnotes.zh: 意即不是申言者受他们灵的管理，乃是他们的灵受他们的支配。因此，他们能断定什么时候该申言，什么时候该停止，好在召会的聚会中维持良好的秩序。他们的灵不是他们的主人，不过是他们尽功用的凭借。他们该学习如何随他们的意思决定，操练并运用他们的灵。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意即不是申言者受他們靈的管理，乃是他們的靈受他們的支配。因此，他們能斷定甚麼時候該申言，甚麼時候該停止，好在召會的聚會中維持良好的秩序。他們的靈不是他們的主人，不過是他們盡功用的憑藉。他們該學習如何隨他們的意思決定，操練並運用他們的靈。
footnotes.en: 14:32 1 spirits This means that the prophets are not under the control of their spirits, but their spirits are under their direction. Thus, they can determine when to prophesy and when to cease prophesying, to maintain good order in the church meeting. Their spirits are not their master but their means to function. They should learn how to exercise and use their spirits at their discretion.

refs.text_gb: 天使又对我说，这些话是可信真实的；主，就是众申言者之灵的神，差遣祂的使者，将那必要快发生的事指示祂的奴仆。
refs.text_big5: 天使又對我說，這些話是可信真實的；主，就是眾申言者之靈的神，差遣祂的使者，將那必要快發生的事指示祂的奴僕。
refs.text_en: And he said to me, These words are faithful and true; and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show to His slaves the things which must quickly take place.

refs.text_gb: 不轻易发怒的，胜过勇士；治服己灵的，强如取城。
refs.text_big5: 不輕易發怒的，勝過勇士；治服己靈的，強如取城。
refs.text_en: He who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; / And he who rules his spirit, than he who captures a city.

verses.text_gb: 因为神不是[Cra]混乱的，乃是[Fn1]和平的。
verses.text_big5: 因為神不是[Cra]混亂的，乃是[Fn1]和平的。
verses.text_en: For God is not a God of confusion but of peace. As in all the churches of the saints,
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为神不是混乱的，乃是和平的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為神不是混亂的，乃是和平的。

footnotes.zh: 本章26～32节的吩咐，主要的是论到说方言和申言，其原则乃是照着神自己的所是，保持和平并合宜的秩序。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本章26～32節的吩咐，主要的是論到說方言和申言，其原則乃是照著神自己的所是，保持和平並合宜的秩序。
footnotes.en: 14:33 1 peace The principle of the charges in vv. 26-32, mainly concerning speaking in tongues and prophesying, is that a peaceful and becoming order, according to what God Himself is, should be kept.

refs.text_gb: 凡事都要端正得体地按着次序行。
refs.text_big5: 凡事都要端正得體的按著次序行。
refs.text_en: But all things must be done becomingly and in order.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]妇女[Fn1][Crb]在召会中要静默，[Fn2]像在[Fn3][Crc]众圣徒的[Crd]众召会中一样，因为不准她们[Fn4]说话；她们乃要[Cre]服从，正如[Fn5][Crf]律法所说的。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]婦女[Fn1][Crb]在召會中要靜默，[Fn2]像在[Fn3][Crc]眾聖徒的[Crd]眾召會中一樣，因為不准她們[Fn4]說話；她們乃要[Cre]服從，正如[Fn5][Crf]律法所說的。
verses.text_en: The women should be silent in the churches, for they are not permitted to speak; but they should be subject, even as the law also says.
verses.text_gb_plain: 妇女在召会中要静默，像在众圣徒的众召会中一样，因为不准她们说话；她们乃要服从，正如律法所说的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 婦女在召會中要靜默，像在眾聖徒的眾召會中一樣，因為不准她們說話；她們乃要服從，正如律法所說的。

footnotes.zh: 意在召会的聚会中。见28注1。下节者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意在召會的聚會中。見28註1。下節者同。
footnotes.en: 14:34 1 in This means in the church meetings. See note 1 Cor. 14:28 1 . So also in v. 35.

footnotes.zh: 这指明众地方召会，在实行上该是一样的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明眾地方召會，在實行上該是一樣的。
footnotes.en: 14:34 2 speak According to 11:5, women may prophesy (of course, in public) with their head covered, and Acts 2:17-18 and Acts 21:9 confirm that women did prophesy. But 1 Tim. 2:12 says that women are not permitted to teach, that is, teach as authorities (there, teaching is related to the exercising of authority), so as to define doctrine. Hence, according to the New Testament principle, for women not to be permitted to speak in the church meetings means that women are not permitted to teach with authority in relation to the defining of doctrine. In this sense they should be silent in the church meetings. They are not permitted to speak, because they should be subject to men. This is related to the matter of authority ordained by God in His government. In God's governmental ordination, women are not permitted to speak with authority over men. They may pray and prophesy, that is, (mainly) speak for the Lord and speak forth the Lord. However, they must do this under the covering of the brothers, because they are charged here to be subject.

footnotes.zh: 一2和十32，提到神的召会，但这里我们读到众圣徒的众召会。神的召会是指召会的构成成分；召会是由神的成分构成的。众圣徒的众召会，指明众召会的组成分子；众召会是由众圣徒组成的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 一2和十32，題到神的召會，但這裏我們讀到眾聖徒的眾召會。神的召會是指召會的構成成分；召會是由神的成分構成的。眾聖徒的眾召會，指明眾召會的組成分子；眾召會是由眾聖徒組成的。
footnotes.en: 14:34 3 law Referring to the books written by Moses (Matt. 5:17; 7:12; 11:13). In Moses' writings, Gen. 3:16 charges the woman to be subject to man's rule. This is God's ordination.

footnotes.zh: 根据十一5，女人蒙着头可以申言(当然是公开的)，在徒二17～18，二一9，也证实有女人申言。然而在提前二12不许女人施教，那是指不可作权柄施教(那里的施教与运用权柄有关)，或断定教义。因此，根据新约的原则，不准女人在召会的聚会中说话，是指不准女人在断定教义的事上用权柄施教。从这意义说，她们在召会的聚会中，应当静默。不准她们说话，因为她们应当服从男人。这与神在祂行政里所命定的权柄有关。在神行政的命定里，不准女人用权柄说话辖管男人。她们可以祷告，也可以申言，主要的乃是为主说话并说出主。然而，她们必须在弟兄的遮盖下作这事，因为这里吩咐她们要服从。
footnotes.zh_big5: 根據十一5，女人蒙著頭可以申言（當然是公開的），在徒二17～18，二一9，也證實有女人申言。然而在提前二12不許女人施教，那是指不可作權柄施教，（那裏的施教與運用權柄有關，）或斷定教義。因此，根據新約的原則，不准女人在召會的聚會中說話，是指不准女人在斷定教義的事上用權柄施教。從這意義說，她們在召會的聚會中，應當靜默。不准她們說話，因為她們應當服從男人。這與神在祂行政裏所命定的權柄有關。在神行政的命定裏，不准女人用權柄說話轄管男人。她們可以禱告，也可以申言，主要的乃是為主說話並說出主。然而，她們必須在弟兄的遮蓋下作這事，因為這裏吩咐她們要服從。

footnotes.zh: 指摩西所写的书(太五17，七12，十一13)。在摩西的著作里，创三16吩咐女人要服从男人的管辖，这是神的命定。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指摩西所寫的書。（太五17，七12，十一13。）在摩西的著作裏，創三16吩咐女人要服從男人的管轄，這是神的命定。

refs.text_gb: 女人要安静学习，凡事服从。
refs.text_big5: 女人要安靜學習，凡事服從。
refs.text_en: Let a woman learn in quietness in all subjection;

refs.text_gb: 我不许女人施教，也不许她揽权辖管男人，只要安静。
refs.text_big5: 我不許女人施教，也不許她攬權轄管男人，只要安靜。
refs.text_en: But I do not permit a woman to teach or to assert authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

refs.text_gb: 但凡女人祷告，或是申言，若不蒙着头，就羞辱自己的头，因为这就如同剃了头发一样。
refs.text_big5: 但凡女人禱告，或是申言，若不蒙著頭，就羞辱自己的頭，因為這就如同剃了頭髮一樣。
refs.text_en: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered disgraces her head; for it is one and the same as she who is shaved.

refs.text_gb: 若没有翻的人，就当在召会中静默，只对自己和神说就是了。
refs.text_big5: 若沒有繙的人，就當在召會中靜默，只對自己和神說就是了。
refs.text_en: But if there is no interpreter, he should be silent in the church, and speak to himself and to God.

refs.text_gb: 第一，我听说你们在召会中聚在一起的时候，你们中间有分裂，我也有几分相信。
refs.text_big5: 第一，我聽說你們在召會中聚在一起的時候，你們中間有分裂，我也有幾分相信。
refs.text_en: For first of all, when you come together in the church, I hear that divisions exist among you; and some part of it I believe.

refs.text_gb: 写信给在哥林多神的召会，就是给在基督耶稣里被圣别，蒙召的圣徒，同着所有在各处呼求我们主耶稣基督之名的人；祂是他们的，也是我们的；
refs.text_big5: 寫信給在哥林多神的召會，就是給在基督耶穌裏被聖別，蒙召的聖徒，同著所有在各處呼求我們主耶穌基督之名的人；祂是他們的，也是我們的；
refs.text_en: To the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who have been sanctified in Christ Jesus, the called saints, with all those who call upon the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, who is theirs and ours:

refs.text_gb: 因此我已打发提摩太到你们那里去；他在主里是我所亲爱、忠信的孩子；他必提醒你们，我在基督耶稣里怎样行事，正如我在各处各召会中所教导的。
refs.text_big5: 因此我已打發提摩太到你們那裏去；他在主裏是我所親愛、忠信的孩子；他必題醒你們，我在基督耶穌裏怎樣行事，正如我在各處各召會中所教導的。
refs.text_en: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every church.

refs.text_gb: 只要照主所分给各人的，和神所召各人的而行。我在众召会中都是这样吩咐。
refs.text_big5: 只要照主所分給各人的，和神所召各人的而行。我在眾召會中都是這樣吩咐。
refs.text_en: However as the Lord has apportioned to each one, as God has called each one, so let him walk. And so I direct in all the churches.

refs.text_gb: 若有人想要强辩，我们却没有这样的规矩，神的众召会也没有。
refs.text_big5: 若有人想要強辯，我們卻沒有這樣的規矩，神的眾召會也沒有。
refs.text_en: But if anyone seems to be contentious, we do not have such a custom of being so, neither the churches of God.

refs.text_gb: 作妻子的，要服从自己的丈夫，如同服从主；
refs.text_big5: 作妻子的，要服從自己的丈夫，如同服從主；
refs.text_en: Wives, be subject to your own husbands as to the Lord;

refs.text_gb: 作妻子的，要服从丈夫，这在主里是相宜的。
refs.text_big5: 作妻子的，要服從丈夫，這在主裏是相宜的。
refs.text_en: Wives, be subject to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

refs.text_gb: 清明自守，贞洁，料理家务，良善，服从自己的丈夫，免得神的话被毁谤。
refs.text_big5: 清明自守，貞潔，料理家務，良善，服從自己的丈夫，免得神的話被毀謗。
refs.text_en: To be of a sober mind, pure, workers at home, good, subject to their own husbands, that the word of God would not be blasphemed.

refs.text_gb: 照样，作妻子的，要服从自己的丈夫，好叫那些甚至不信从主话的，也可以不用主的话，借着妻子的品行，被主得着，
refs.text_big5: 照樣，作妻子的，要服從自己的丈夫，好叫那些甚至不信從主話的，也可以不用主的話，藉著妻子的品行，被主得著，
refs.text_en: In like manner, wives, be subject to your own husbands, that even if any disobey the word, they will be gained without the word through the manner of life of their wives,

refs.text_gb: 律法上记着：“主说，我要用异邦人的舌头，和异邦人的嘴唇，向这百姓说话；虽然如此，他们还是不听从我。”
refs.text_big5: 律法上記著：“主說，我要用異邦人的舌頭，和異邦人的嘴脣，向這百姓說話；雖然如此，他們還是不聽從我。”
refs.text_en: In the law it is written, "By those of other tongues and with the lips of others I will speak to this people; even so they will not listen to Me, says the Lord."

verses.text_gb: 她们若想要学什么，可以在家里问自己的丈夫，因为妇女在召会中说话，是可耻的。
verses.text_big5: 她們若想要學甚麼，可以在家裏問自己的丈夫，因為婦女在召會中說話，是可恥的。
verses.text_en: But if they desire to learn anything, they should ask their own husbands at home; for it is a shame for a woman to speak in the church.
verses.text_gb_plain: 她们若想要学什么，可以在家里问自己的丈夫，因为妇女在召会中说话，是可耻的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 她們若想要學甚麼，可以在家裏問自己的丈夫，因為婦女在召會中說話，是可恥的。

verses.text_gb: 神的话岂是从你们出来么？[Fn1]岂是单临到你们么？
verses.text_big5: 神的話豈是從你們出來麼？[Fn1]豈是單臨到你們麼？
verses.text_en: Or was it from you that the word of God went forth? Or did it reach only to you?
verses.text_gb_plain: 神的话岂是从你们出来么？岂是单临到你们么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 神的話豈是從你們出來麼？豈是單臨到你們麼？

footnotes.zh: 这也指明一地的召会，在实行上该效法其他各地的召会。众地方召会都当照着从使徒出来之神的话，服从那灵普遍性的吩咐。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這也指明一地的召會，在實行上該效法其他各地的召會。眾地方召會都當照著從使徒出來之神的話，服從那靈普遍性的吩咐。
footnotes.en: 14:36 1 did This too indicates that a local church should follow the other churches in its practice. All the local churches should submit to the universal order of the Spirit according to the word of the apostles, from whom the word of God goes forth.

verses.text_gb: 若有人自以为是[Fn1][Cra]申言者，或是[Crb]属灵的，就该清楚知道，我所写给你们的是[Fn2][Crc]主的命令。
verses.text_big5: 若有人自以為是[Fn1][Cra]申言者，或是[Crb]屬靈的，就該清楚知道，我所寫給你們的是[Fn2][Crc]主的命令。
verses.text_en: If anyone thinks he is a prophet or spiritual, let him fully know the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.
verses.text_gb_plain: 若有人自以为是申言者，或是属灵的，就该清楚知道，我所写给你们的是主的命令。
verses.text_big5_plain: 若有人自以為是申言者，或是屬靈的，就該清楚知道，我所寫給你們的是主的命令。

footnotes.zh: 这也指明为着完成神新约的经纶，申言者或属灵的人，在召会中是极受重视的。申言者是神在召会的行政里，仅次于使徒的人(十二28)。他为神说话并说出神，他也领受关于基督与召会之奥秘的启示(弗三5)，作建造召会的根基(弗二20)。属灵的人，乃是照着他与神的灵调和的灵生活行动，且能辨别一切属灵之事的人(三1，二15与注)。这样在属灵上有知识的人，应当清楚知道，使徒保罗的教训乃是主的命令，他们所说的话应当与使徒的教训相符。保罗对付混乱的哥林多人时，他的灵是刚强的，话是率直的。他嘱咐他们要确实知道，他的教训就是主的命令，有主真实的权柄。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這也指明為著完成神新約的經綸，申言者或屬靈的人，在召會中是極受重視的。申言者是神在召會的行政裏，僅次於使徒的人。（十二28。）他為神說話並說出神，他也領受關於基督與召會之奧祕的啟示，（弗三5，）作建造召會的根基。（弗二20。）屬靈的人，乃是照著他與神的靈調和的靈生活行動，且能辨別一切屬靈之事的人。（三1，二15與註。）這樣在屬靈上有知識的人，應當清楚知道，使徒保羅的教訓乃是主的命令，他們所說的話應當與使徒的教訓相符。保羅對付混亂的哥林多人時，他的靈是剛強的，話是率直的。他囑咐他們要確實知道，他的教訓就是主的命令，有主真實的權柄。
footnotes.en: 14:37 1 prophet Prophet - is one who speaks for God and speaks forth God, and who has received revelation of the mysteries concerning Christ and the church (Eph. 3:5), which revelation is the foundation for the building of the church (Eph. 2:20). A spiritual person is one who lives according to his spirit, which is mingled with God's Spirit, and who is able to discern all the spiritual things (1 Cor. 3:1 and notes; 1 Cor. 2:15 and note). Such spiritually knowledgeable persons should fully know that the apostle Paul's teachings are the commandment of the Lord, and their speaking should correspond with his teachings. Paul's spirit was strong and his word was frank in dealing with the disorderly Corinthians.

footnotes.zh: 使徒的教训既是按照神的命定(34)，这些教训就是主的命令。
footnotes.zh_big5: 使徒的教訓既是按照神的命定，（34，）這些教訓就是主的命令。
footnotes.en: 14:37 2 commandment Since the apostle's teachings are according to God's ordination (v. 34), they are the commandment of the Lord.

refs.text_gb: 神在召会中所设立的，第一是使徒，第二是申言者，第三是教师；其次是行异能的，再次是得恩赐医病的，帮助的，治理的，说各种方言的。
refs.text_big5: 神在召會中所設立的，第一是使徒，第二是申言者，第三是教師；其次是行異能的，再次是得恩賜醫病的，幫助的，治理的，說各種方言的。
refs.text_en: And God has placed some in the church: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers; then works of power, then gifts of healing, helps, administrations, various kinds of tongues.

refs.text_gb: 岂都是使徒么？岂都是申言者么？岂都是教师么？岂都是行异能的么？
refs.text_big5: 豈都是使徒麼？豈都是申言者麼？豈都是教師麼？豈都是行異能的麼？
refs.text_en: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all have works of power?

refs.text_gb: 唯有属灵的人看透万事，却没有一人看透他。
refs.text_big5: 惟有屬靈的人看透萬事，卻沒有一人看透他。
refs.text_en: But the spiritual man discerns all things, but he himself is discerned by no one.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，我从前对你们说话，不能把你们当作属灵的，只能当作属肉的，当作在基督里的婴孩。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，我從前對你們說話，不能把你們當作屬靈的，只能當作屬肉的，當作在基督裏的嬰孩。
refs.text_en: And I, brothers, was not able to speak to you as to spiritual men, but as to fleshy, as to infants in Christ.

refs.text_gb: 至于那已婚的，我吩咐他们，其实不是我吩咐，乃是主吩咐，说，妻子不可离开丈夫。
refs.text_big5: 至於那已婚的，我吩咐他們，其實不是我吩咐，乃是主吩咐，說，妻子不可離開丈夫。
refs.text_en: But to the married I charge, not I but the Lord, A wife must not be separated from her husband

refs.text_gb: 关于童身的人，我没有主的命令，但我既蒙主怜悯成为忠信的，就提出我的意见。
refs.text_big5: 關於童身的人，我沒有主的命令，但我既蒙主憐憫成為忠信的，就題出我的意見。
refs.text_en: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord, but I give my opinion as one who has been shown mercy by the Lord to be faithful.

verses.text_gb: 但若有人[Cra]不理会，就由他不理会吧。
verses.text_big5: 但若有人[Cra]不理會，就由他不理會罷。
verses.text_en: But if anyone ignores this, let him ignore it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但若有人不理会，就由他不理会吧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但若有人不理會，就由他不理會罷。

refs.text_gb: 因为弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道，我们的祖宗从前都在云下，都从海中经过；
refs.text_big5: 因為弟兄們，我不願意你們不知道，我們的祖宗從前都在雲下，都從海中經過；
refs.text_en: For I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers, that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，关于属灵的恩赐，我不愿意你们不明白。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，關於屬靈的恩賜，我不願意你們不明白。
refs.text_en: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be ignorant.

verses.text_gb: 所以我弟兄们，你们要[Fn1][Cra]切慕[Crb]申言，也不要禁止说方言。
verses.text_big5: 所以我弟兄們，你們要[Fn1][Cra]切慕[Crb]申言，也不要禁止說方言。
verses.text_en: So then, my brothers, desire earnestly the prophesying, and do not forbid the speaking in tongues.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以我弟兄们，你们要切慕申言，也不要禁止说方言。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以我弟兄們，你們要切慕申言，也不要禁止說方言。

footnotes.zh: 事实上，本章全是论到申言和说方言。在用基督之丰富的职事，建造众圣徒与召会上，申言既是最有益的恩赐，就为使徒所看重并提倡。说方言对这样的建造，既没有丝毫益处，使徒就忠信的揭露它较小的价值。使徒的看重并揭露，都是根据他关切神定旨的完成，就是用基督的丰富建造召会。到了本章的结语，他仍然嘱咐我们要为着神的建造切慕申言。然而，他也嘱咐我们不要禁止说方言，以保守召会的包罗与合一。
footnotes.en: 14:39 1 desire; do Actually, this entire chapter deals with prophesying and speaking in tongues. Since prophesying is the most profitable gift for building up both the saints and the church with the rich ministry of Christ, it was highly esteemed and promoted by the apostle. Since speaking in tongues affords no profit for building up, the apostle was faithful to expose its lesser value. Both the apostle's esteeming and his exposing were according to his concern for the fulfilling of God's purpose in building up the church with the riches of Christ. At the conclusion of this chapter he still charged us to desire earnestly to prophesy for God's building. However, in order to keep the all-inclusiveness and oneness of the church, he also charged us not to forbid speaking in tongues.

refs.text_gb: 但你们要切慕那更大的恩赐。我还要把极超越的路指示你们。
refs.text_big5: 但你們要切慕那更大的恩賜。我還要把極超越的路指示你們。
refs.text_en: But earnestly desire the greater gifts. And moreover I show to you a most excellent way.

refs.text_gb: 我若有申言的恩赐，也明白一切的奥秘，和一切的知识，并有全备的信，以致能够移山，却没有爱，我就算不得什么。
refs.text_big5: 我若有申言的恩賜，也明白一切的奧祕，和一切的知識，並有全備的信，以致能彀移山，卻沒有愛，我就算不得甚麼。
refs.text_en: And if I have the gift of prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to remove mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.

refs.text_gb: 你们要追求爱，更要切慕属灵的恩赐，尤其要切慕申言。
refs.text_big5: 你們要追求愛，更要切慕屬靈的恩賜，尤其要切慕申言。
refs.text_en: Pursue love, and desire earnestly spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

refs.text_gb: 但那申言的，是对人讲说建造、勉励和安慰。
refs.text_big5: 但那申言的，是對人講說建造、勉勵和安慰。
refs.text_en: But he who prophesies speaks building up and encouragement and consolation to men.

refs.text_gb: 那说方言的，是建造自己，但那申言的，乃是建造召会。
refs.text_big5: 那說方言的，是建造自己，但那申言的，乃是建造召會。
refs.text_en: He who speaks in a tongue builds up himself, but he who prophesies builds up the church.

refs.text_gb: 我愿意你们都说方言，但我更愿意你们申言；说方言的，若不翻出来，使召会得建造，那申言的，就比他强了。
refs.text_big5: 我願意你們都說方言，但我更願意你們申言；說方言的，若不繙出來，使召會得建造，那申言的，就比他強了。
refs.text_en: I desire that you all speak in tongues, but especially that you would prophesy; and greater is he who prophesies than he who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, that the church may receive building up.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，我到你们那里去，若只说方言，与你们有什么益处？除非我用启示，或知识，或预言，或教训，对你们讲说。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，我到你們那裏去，若只說方言，與你們有甚麼益處？除非我用啟示，或知識，或豫言，或教訓，對你們講說。
refs.text_en: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, what will I profit you, unless I speak to you either in revelation or in knowledge or in prophecy or in teaching?

verses.text_gb: 凡事都要[Fn1]端正得体地按着[Cra]次序行。
verses.text_big5: 凡事都要[Fn1]端正得體的按著[Cra]次序行。
verses.text_en: But all things must be done becomingly and in order.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡事都要端正得体地按着次序行。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡事都要端正得體的按著次序行。

footnotes.zh: 使徒对召会所关切的，乃是基督作神的中心，以及召会作神的目标，得以实行并完成，且得以在人和天使面前(四9，十一10)，凡事行得端正得体，有秩有序。要完成这样高的目的，我们天然的生命是无用的。正当的召会生活，需要经历钉十字架的基督(一23，二2)，以了结我们的己，并经历在复活里的基督，作我们每日的圣别和救赎(一30)。
footnotes.en: 14:40 1 becomingly; order The apostle's concern for the church was that Christ as God's center and the church as God's goal might be carried on and carried out, with all things done becomingly and in good order before men and the angels (1 Cor. 4:9; 11:10). Our natural life is useless in fulfilling such a high purpose. The experience of Christ crucified (1 Cor. 1:23; 2:2) for the termination of our self and the experience of Christ in resurrection as our daily sanctification and redemption (1 Cor. 1:30) are needed for a proper church life.

refs.text_gb: 我在肉身里虽然离开，在灵里却与你们同在，欢喜看见你们整齐有序，并坚定地信入基督。
refs.text_big5: 我在肉身裏雖然離開，在靈裏卻與你們同在，歡喜看見你們整齊有序，並堅定的信入基督。
refs.text_en: For even though I am absent in the flesh, yet in the spirit I am with you, rejoicing and seeing your order and the solid basis of your faith in Christ.

refs.text_gb: 因为神不是混乱的，乃是和平的。
refs.text_big5: 因為神不是混亂的，乃是和平的。
refs.text_en: For God is not a God of confusion but of peace. As in all the churches of the saints,

verses.text_gb: 弟兄们，我要你们明白我先前所传与你们的[Fn1][Cra]福音，这福音你们也领受了，又在其中[Fn2][Crb]站住；
verses.text_big5: 弟兄們，我要你們明白我先前所傳與你們的[Fn1][Cra]福音，這福音你們也領受了，又在其中[Fn2][Crb]站住；
verses.text_en: Now I make known to you, brothers, the gospel which I announced to you, which also you received, in which also you stand,
verses.text_gb_plain: 弟兄们，我要你们明白我先前所传与你们的福音，这福音你们也领受了，又在其中站住；
verses.text_big5_plain: 弟兄們，我要你們明白我先前所傳與你們的福音，這福音你們也領受了，又在其中站住；

footnotes.zh: 指完全的福音，包括关于基督与召会的教训，如在罗马书中所完全揭示的(罗一1，十六25)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指完全的福音，包括關於基督與召會的教訓，如在羅馬書中所完全揭示的。（羅一1，十六25。）
footnotes.en: 15:1 1 gospel The full gospel, including the teachings concerning Christ and the church, as fully disclosed in the book of Romans (Rom. 1:1; 16:25).

footnotes.zh: 我们应当站在完全的福音，就是整本的新约上，而不是只站在一些教训或道理上。
footnotes.zh_big5: 我們應當站在完全的福音，就是整本的新約上，而不是只站在一些教訓或道理上。
footnotes.en: 15:1 2 stand We should stand in the full gospel, that is, in the entire New Testament, not just in certain teachings or doctrines.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，我要你们知道，那借着我所传的福音，并不是照着人意的，
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，我要你們知道，那藉著我所傳的福音，並不是照著人意的，
refs.text_en: For I make known to you, brothers, concerning the gospel announced by me, that it is not according to man.

refs.text_gb: 你要记念那从死人中得复活的耶稣基督，祂是出于大卫的后裔，这正合乎我所传的福音；
refs.text_big5: 你要記念那從死人中得復活的耶穌基督，祂是出於大衛的後裔，這正合乎我所傳的福音；
refs.text_en: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my gospel,

refs.text_gb: 基督耶稣的奴仆保罗，蒙召的使徒，被分别出来归于神福音的；
refs.text_big5: 基督耶穌的奴僕保羅，蒙召的使徒，被分別出來歸於神福音的；
refs.text_en: Paul, a slave of Christ Jesus, a called apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

refs.text_gb: 就是在神借耶稣基督，照着我的福音，审判人隐秘事的日子。
refs.text_big5: 就是在神藉耶穌基督，照著我的福音，審判人隱祕事的日子。
refs.text_en: In the day when God judges the secrets of men according to my gospel through Jesus Christ.

refs.text_gb: 神能照我的福音，就是关于耶稣基督的传扬，照历世以来密而不宣之奥秘的启示，坚固你们；
refs.text_big5: 神能照我的福音，就是關於耶穌基督的傳揚，照歷世以來密而不宣之奧祕的啟示，堅固你們；
refs.text_en: Now to Him who is able to establish you according to my gospel, that is, the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which has been kept in silence in the times of the ages

refs.text_gb: 只要你们行事为人配得过基督的福音，叫我或来见你们，或不在你们那里，可以听见关于你们的事，就是你们在一个灵里站立得住，同魂与福音的信仰一齐努力；
refs.text_big5: 只要你們行事為人配得過基督的福音，叫我或來見你們，或不在你們那裏，可以聽見關於你們的事，就是你們在一個靈裏站立得住，同魂與福音的信仰一齊努力；
refs.text_en: Only, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ, that whether coming and seeing you or being absent, I may hear of the things concerning you, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving together along with the faith of the gospel,

refs.text_gb: 我们并不是作主管辖你们的信心，乃是与你们同工，使你们喜乐，因为你们是凭信而立。
refs.text_big5: 我們並不是作主管轄你們的信心，乃是與你們同工，使你們喜樂，因為你們是憑信而立。
refs.text_en: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy; for by faith you stand.

refs.text_gb: 我们又借着祂，因信得进入现在所站的这恩典中，并且因盼望神的荣耀而夸耀。
refs.text_big5: 我們又藉著祂，因信得進入現在所站的這恩典中，並且因盼望神的榮耀而誇耀。
refs.text_en: Through whom also we have obtained access by faith into this grace in which we stand and boast because of the hope of the glory of God.

refs.text_gb: 我借着我所看为忠信的弟兄西拉，略略地写了这信给你们，劝勉你们，又充分见证这是神真实的恩典；你们务要进入这恩典，并在其中站住。
refs.text_big5: 我藉著我所看為忠信的弟兄西拉，略略的寫了這信給你們，勸勉你們，又充分見證這是神真實的恩典；你們務要進入這恩典，並在其中站住。
refs.text_en: Through Silvanus, the faithful brother, as I account him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying fully that this is the true grace of God; enter into this grace and stand in it.

verses.text_gb: 你们若[Cra]持守我所传与你们为福音的话，也必借这福音[Fn1]逐渐[Crb]得救，除非你们是[Crc]徒然相信。
verses.text_big5: 你們若[Cra]持守我所傳與你們為福音的話，也必藉這福音[Fn1]逐漸[Crb]得救，除非你們是[Crc]徒然相信。
verses.text_en: Through which also you are being saved, if you hold fast the word which I announced to you as the gospel, unless you have believed in vain.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们若持守我所传与你们为福音的话，也必借这福音逐渐得救，除非你们是徒然相信。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們若持守我所傳與你們為福音的話，也必藉這福音逐漸得救，除非你們是徒然相信。

footnotes.zh: 或，在得救的路上(Conybeare，康尼拜尔)。我们在基督里得称义，并由那灵重生后，就在凭基督的生命得救的过程中(罗五10)，直到我们成熟，完全模成祂的形像(罗八29)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，在得救的路上。（Conybeare，康尼拜爾。）我們在基督裏得稱義，並由那靈重生後，就在憑基督的生命得救的過程中，（羅五10，）直到我們成熟，完全模成祂的形像。（羅八29。）
footnotes.en: 15:2 1 being Or, in the way of salvation (Conybeare). Having been justified in Christ and regenerated by the Spirit, we are in the process of being saved in the life of Christ (Rom. 5:10), and will be until we are mature and conformed to Him in full (Rom. 8:29).

refs.text_gb: 但基督为儿子，治理神的家；我们若将因盼望而有的胆量和夸耀坚守到底，便是祂的家了。
refs.text_big5: 但基督為兒子，治理神的家；我們若將因盼望而有的膽量和誇耀堅守到底，便是祂的家了。

footnotes.zh: 本节三次所提到的恩，乃是复活的基督成了赐生命的灵(45)，在复活里将经过过程的三一神带到我们里面，作我们的生命和生命的供应，使我们能在复活里活着。因此，恩乃是三一神成了我们的生命和一切(见约一17注1，加二21注1)。大数的扫罗原是罪人中的罪魁(提前一15～16)，但因着这恩竟成了最前面的使徒，比众使徒格外劳苦。他靠这恩而有的职事和生活，对基督的复活乃是人无法否认的见证。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本節三次所題到的恩，乃是復活的基督成了賜生命的靈，（45，）在復活裏將經過過程的三一神帶到我們裏面，作我們的生命和生命的供應，使我們能在復活裏活著。因此，恩乃是三一神成了我們的生命和一切。（見約一17註1，加二21註1。）大數的掃羅原是罪人中的罪魁，（提前一15～16，）但因著這恩竟成了最前面的使徒，比眾使徒格外勞苦。他靠這恩而有的職事和生活，對基督的復活乃是人無法否認的見證。
footnotes.en: 15:10 1 grace Grace, mentioned three times in this verse, is the resurrected Christ becoming the life-giving Spirit (v. 45) to bring the processed Triune God in resurrection into us to be our life and life supply that we may live in resurrection. Thus, grace is the Triune God becoming life and everything to us. (See note John 1:17 1 and note Gal. 2:21 1 .) It is by this grace that Saul of Tarsus, the foremost of sinners (1 Tim. 1:15-16), became the foremost apostle, laboring more abundantly than all the apostles. His ministry and living by this grace are an undeniable testimony to Christ's resurrection.

footnotes.zh: “不是我，乃是神的恩，”等于加二20所说的“不再是我，乃是基督。”那推动使徒并在他里面运行的恩，不是任何事物，乃是一位活的人位，复活的基督，父神的具体化身，成了包罗万有赐生命的灵，住在使徒里面，作他的一切。
footnotes.zh_big5: “不是我，乃是神的恩，”等於加二20所說的“不再是我，乃是基督。”那推動使徒並在他裏面運行的恩，不是任何事物，乃是一位活的人位，復活的基督，父神的具體化身，成了包羅萬有賜生命的靈，住在使徒裏面，作他的一切。
footnotes.en: 15:10 2 not Not I but the grace of God equals no longer I ...but...Christ in Gal. 2:20. The grace that motivated the apostle and operated in him was not some matter or some thing but a living person, the resurrected Christ, the embodiment of God the Father who became the all-inclusive life-giving Spirit, who dwelt in the apostle as his everything.

verses.text_gb: 既传基督从死人中[Cra]复活了，怎么在你们中间，有人说[Fn1]没有死人的复活？

verses.text_gb_plain: 既传基督从死人中复活了，怎么在你们中间，有人说没有死人的复活？
verses.text_big5_plain: 既傳基督從死人中復活了，怎麼在你們中間，有人說沒有死人的復活？

footnotes.zh: 在本章，使徒对付哥林多人异端的说法，说没有死人的复活。他们好像撒都该人一样(太二二23，徒二三8)。这是他们中间的第十个难处，这难处损害、败坏神新约的经纶，比提后二17～18，许米乃和腓理徒论到复活的异端更严重。复活乃是神圣经纶的命脉和生命线，若没有复活，神就是死人的神，不是活人的神(太二二32)。若没有复活，基督就没有从死人中复活，祂就是死的救主，不是活的救主。但祂是活着的，是那要活到永永远远地(启一18)，能拯救我们到底(来七25)。若没有复活，就没有借着祂的死得称义的活证据(罗四25与注)，没有生命的分赐(约十二24)，没有重生(约三5)，没有更新(多三5)，没有变化(罗十二2，林后三18)，也没有基督形像的模成(罗八29)。若没有复活，就没有基督的肢体(罗十二5)，没有基督的身体作祂的丰满(弗一20～23)，没有召会作基督的新妇(约三29)，也就没有新人(弗二15，四24，西三10～11)。若没有复活，神新约的经纶就完全崩溃，神永远的定旨也要归于无有了。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在本章，使徒對付哥林多人異端的說法，說沒有死人的復活。他們好像撒都該人一樣。（太二二23，徒二三8。）這是他們中間的第十個難處，這難處損害、敗壞神新約的經綸，比提後二17～18，許米乃和腓理徒論到復活的異端更嚴重。復活乃是神聖經綸的命脈和生命線，若沒有復活，神就是死人的神，不是活人的神。（太二二32。）若沒有復活，基督就沒有從死人中復活，祂就是死的救主，不是活的救主。但祂是活著的，是那要活到永永遠遠的，（啟一18，）能拯救我們到底。（來七25。）若沒有復活，就沒有藉著祂的死得稱義的活證據，（羅四25與註，）沒有生命的分賜，（約十二24，）沒有重生，（約三5，）沒有更新，（多三5，）沒有變化，（羅十二2，林後三18，）也沒有基督形像的模成。（羅八29。）若沒有復活，就沒有基督的肢體，（羅十二5，）沒有基督的身體作祂的豐滿，（弗一20～23，）沒有召會作基督的新婦，（約三29，）也就沒有新人。（弗二15，四24，西三10～11。）若沒有復活，神新約的經綸就完全崩潰，神永遠的定旨也要歸於無有了。
footnotes.en: 15:12 1 no In this chapter the apostle dealt with the Corinthians' heretical saying that there is no resurrection of the dead. The Corinthians were like the Sadducees (Matt. 22:23; Acts 23:8). This was the tenth problem among them. It is the most damaging and destructive to God's New Testament economy, worse than the heresy of Hymenaeus and Philetus concerning resurrection (2 Tim. 2:17-18). Resurrection is the life pulse and lifeline of the divine economy. If there were no resurrection, God would be the God of the dead, not of the living (Matt. 22:32). If there were no resurrection, Christ would not have been raised from the dead. He would be a dead Savior, not a living One who lives forever (Rev. 1:18) and is able to save to the uttermost (Heb. 7:25). If there were no resurrection, there would be no living proof of our being justified by His death (Rom. 4:25 and note), no imparting of life (John 12:24), no regeneration (John 3:5), no renewing (Titus 3:5), no transformation (Rom. 12:2; 2 Cor. 3:18), and no conformity to the image of Christ (Rom. 8:29). If there were no resurrection, there would be no members of Christ (Rom. 12:5), no Body of Christ as His fullness (Eph. 1:20-23), and no church as Christ's bride (John 3:29), and therefore no new man (Eph. 2:15; 4:24; Col. 3:10-11). If there were no resurrection, God's New Testament economy would altogether collapse and God's eternal purpose would be nullified.

refs.text_en: Holding forth the word of life, so that I may have a boast in the day of Christ that I did not run in vain nor labor in vain.

refs.text_en: Through which also you are being saved, if you hold fast the word which I announced to you as the gospel, unless you have believed in vain.

footnotes.en: 15:17 1 futile I.e., fruitless, worthless. If Christ had not been resurrected to live in us as our life and everything, our faith in Him would be fruitless, worthless, and without any issue, such as the impartation of life, freedom from sin, victory over Satan, and growth in life.

footnotes.zh: 基督的死，是拯救我们脱离罪(复数)的定罪，不是拯救我们脱离罪(单数)的权势。基督复活的生命，才拯救我们脱离罪的权势(罗八2)。基督若没有复活，我们就仍在罪(复数)里，并在罪(单数)的权势之下。
footnotes.zh_big5: 基督的死，是拯救我們脫離罪（複數）的定罪，不是拯救我們脫離罪（單數）的權勢。基督復活的生命，纔拯救我們脫離罪的權勢。（羅八2。）基督若沒有復活，我們就仍在罪（複數）裏，並在罪（單數）的權勢之下。
footnotes.en: 15:17 2 still Christ's death saves us from being condemned because of our sins, not from the power of sin. It is His resurrection life that delivers us from the power of sin (Rom. 8:2). If Christ had not been resurrected, we would still remain in sins and under the power of sin.

refs.text_en: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are living, who are left remaining unto the coming of the Lord, shall by no means precede those who have fallen asleep;

refs.text_en: And I heard a voice out of heaven, saying, Write, Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on. Yes, says the Spirit, that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.

footnotes.zh: 若没有复活，我们就没有将来，对将来也没有盼望，就如基督是我们荣耀的盼望(西一27)、我们永远的福分(但十二13)、在千年国里与基督的同王(启二十4，6)以及义人复活的赏赐(路十四14)。这些盼望都系于我们的复活。
footnotes.zh_big5: 若沒有復活，我們就沒有將來，對將來也沒有盼望，就如基督是我們榮耀的盼望、（西一27、）我們永遠的福分、（但十二13、）在千年國裏與基督的同王、（啟二十4，6、）以及義人復活的賞賜。（路十四14。）這些盼望都繫於我們的復活。
footnotes.en: 15:19 1 only If there were no resurrection, we would have no future and no hope for the future, such as Christ as our hope of glory (Col. 1:27), the lot of our eternal blessing (Dan. 12:13), the reign with Christ in the millennium (Rev. 20:4, 6), and the reward of the resurrection of the just (Luke 14:14). All these hopes are connected to our resurrection.

footnotes.zh: 基督是第一位从死人中复活的，是复活的初熟果子。这是利二三10～11，在安息日的次日，就是复活之日(太二八1)，献给神的初熟果子所预表的(一捆初熟的果子，包括基督和一些死了的旧约圣徒，在主复活时起来——太二七52～53)。基督这复活的初熟果子，乃是从死人中复活的首生者，成了祂身体的头(西一18，弗一20～23)。基督——身体的头——既已复活，我们——身体——也必复活。
footnotes.zh_big5: 基督是第一位從死人中復活的，是復活的初熟果子。這是利二三10～11，在安息日的次日，就是復活之日，（太二八1，）獻給神的初熟果子所豫表的。（一捆初熟的果子，包括基督和一些死了的舊約聖徒，在主復活時起來─太二七52～53。）基督這復活的初熟果子，乃是從死人中復活的首生者，成了祂身體的頭。（西一18，弗一20～23。）基督─身體的頭─既已復活，我們─身體─也必復活。
footnotes.en: 15:20 2 firstfruits Christ was the first One raised from among the dead, becoming the firstfruits of resurrection. This was typified by the firstfruits (a sheaf of the firstfruits, including Christ with some of the dead Old Testament saints, was raised at the Lord's resurrection — Matt. 27:52-53) in Lev. 23:10-11, which were offered to God on the day after the Sabbath, the day of resurrection (Matt. 28:1). Christ as the firstfruits of resurrection is the Firstborn from among the dead that He might be the Head of the Body (Col. 1:18; Eph. 1:20-23). Since He, the Head of the Body, has been resurrected, we, the Body, also will be resurrected.

footnotes.zh: 指第二个人基督(47)。亚当借着罪带进死(罗五12)；基督借着义带进复活的生命(罗五17～18)。亚当所带进的死，一直在我们里面作工，从我们由父母出生起，直到我们身体死了为止。基督所带进的复活生命，在我们里面运行，就如受浸所表征的(罗六4)，从我们借着神的灵重生(约三5)，直到我们身体改变形状(腓三21)。

footnotes.en: 15:21 2 man I.e., Christ, the second man (v. 47). Adam brought in death through sin (Rom. 5:12); Christ brought in the life of resurrection through righteousness (Rom. 5:17-18). The death brought in by Adam works in us from our birth by our parents until the death of our body. The life of resurrection brought in by Christ operates in us, as signified by baptism (Rom. 6:4), from our regeneration by the Spirit of God (John 3:5) until the transfiguration of our body (Phil. 3:21).
